items.title: 美聯邦航空總署下令「全美航班暫停起飛」
items.title_en: U.S. Federal Aviation Administration Orders Nationwide Flight Halt
paras: 美國聯邦航空總署 (FAA) 週五 (13 日) 下午發布全國性地面停飛令前，芝加哥地區已傳出航管通訊異常，部分飛往芝加哥歐海爾(Chicago O"Hare International Airport) 及中途機場的航班被要求留在出發地。
FAA 隨後以「特殊情況」及飛安考量為由，要求全美尚未起飛的離港航班暫停起飛，飛往美國的國際航班則逐案處理。
截至台灣時間週六 (14 日) 清晨5時20分許，FAA 尚未證實芝加哥的通訊異常是否與全國停飛有關，停飛令是否解除也尚待確認。
回顧歷史，全美地面停飛實屬相當罕見。
上一次發生的時間點是 2023 年 1 月 11 日，FAA 的飛航通告 (NOTAM) 系統故障，影響機組員取得跑道關閉、臨時空域限制等飛安資訊。FAA 因此下令全美航班暫停起飛，約一個半小時後解除，但當天仍有約 9,000 班航班延誤、1,300 班取消。
FAA 事後查明，承包商人員在處理主資料庫與備份資料庫的同步問題時，意外刪除檔案。
再往前一次是 2001 年 9 月 11 日。
兩架遭劫持的客機先後撞上紐約世界貿易中心雙塔後，FAA 於美東時間上午約 9 時 25 分下令全美民航機停止起飛，並於上午 9 時 45 分要求已在空中的航班儘速在最近的機場降落。
當時有逾 4,500 架飛機在空中。到了中午約 12 時 15 分，美國本土 48 州上空的商用及私人航班已全數降落。這是美國史上首次因突發事件關閉全國民航空域。
paras_en: Before the FAA issued a nationwide ground stop on Friday (the 13th) in the afternoon, abnormal air‑traffic communications were reported in the Chicago area, and some flights bound for Chicago O'Hare International Airport and intermediate airports were instructed to remain at their departure points.

The FAA then, citing “special circumstances” and flight‑safety considerations, ordered all U.S. departures that had not yet taken off to pause, while inbound international flights to the United States would be handled on a case‑by‑case basis.

As of about 5:20 a.m. Taiwan time on Saturday (the 14th), the FAA had not confirmed whether the Chicago communications issue was related to the nationwide halt, and it had not yet announced when the stop order would be lifted.
Historically, a nationwide ground halt in the United States is extremely rare.

The last occurrence was on January 11 2023, when a failure in the FAA’s NOTAM system prevented crews from receiving runway‑closure and temporary airspace‑restriction information. The FAA ordered a nationwide flight pause, which was lifted about an hour and a half later, but that day still saw roughly 9,000 delayed flights and 1,300 cancellations.
The FAA later determined that a contractor accidentally deleted files while addressing a synchronization issue between the primary and backup databases.
The previous nationwide halt was on September 11 2001.

After the two hijacked aircraft struck the World Trade Center towers, the FAA ordered all civil aviation in the United States to stop taking off at about 9:25 a.m. Eastern Time and, at 9:45 a.m., instructed flights already in the air to land at the nearest airport as quickly as possible.

At that time more than 4,500 aircraft were airborne. By roughly 12:15 p.m., all commercial and private flights over the contiguous 48 states had landed, marking the first time in U.S. history that the entire national airspace was closed due to an emergency.

items.title: 黃仁勳下台後 科技巨頭與白宮的「好交情」恐變燙手山芋
items.title_en: After Jensen Huang Steps Down, the ‘Good Relationship’ Between Tech Giants and the White House May Turn Into a Hot Potato
paras: 黃仁勳離開輝達(NVDA-US)後，衝擊可能不只停留在公司內部。《CNBC》分析指出，隨著民主黨在美國期中選舉大勝，加上選民對貪腐與政商關係的不滿升高，科技企業與白宮的密切往來可能面臨更嚴格檢視，甚至推動監管政策從鬆綁轉向收緊。
對投資人而言，接下來的觀察重點，除了輝達接班與營運前景，也包括晶片出口、AI立法及資料中心政策是否改變。企業過去透過高層人脈直接參與政策討論的模式，可能成為新的政治風險。

選民不滿政商過從甚密 黃仁勳風波成焦點

《CNBC》選民調查顯示，90%受訪者認為貪腐是影響投票決定的關鍵或重大議題，比生活成本高出1個百分點。至於哪個政黨更有能力處理貪腐，民主黨以37%領先共和黨的30%，但也有32%認為兩黨都不行。
選前另一項調查則顯示，93%受訪者反對總統與國會議員等民選官員，個人持有或交易與聯邦政府簽約公司的股票；89%反對總統家族成員取得政府合約，反映跨黨派選民對利益衝突的疑慮。
《CNBC》認為，黃仁勳事件正好觸及這些敏感問題。輝達與其他大型企業曾向川普的宴會廳建設計畫捐款；另一方面，政府也面臨指控，被質疑在獲悉輝達晶片可能非法流向中國後，未採取適當行動。
分析指出，川普政府是否忽視內部警訊，仍讓黃仁勳隨行訪中並參與晶片出口政策討論，將成為外界追問的焦點。不過，相關質疑尚不能直接等同違法或利益交換已獲證實。

國會可能加強科技監管 企業與白宮關係面臨重估

參議員華倫已釋出強化監管訊號，主張國會應通過《AI Overwatch Act》等跨黨派法案，防止美國先進AI技術流入中國。她表示，不能仰賴大型科技公司的億萬富豪執行長，自行將國家安全置於獲利之上。
《CNBC》分析，政策變化可能先從企業與政治保持更清楚距離開始，減少商界對政策的直接影響；若民意壓力持續升高，也可能演變為更廣泛的監管調整。金融海嘯後銀行業受到更嚴格規範，就是公眾不滿推動政策轉向的歷史例子，但不代表科技業必然重演相同情況。
即使民主黨在國會兩院取得大幅優勢，也未必具備推翻總統否決所需的票數，因此政策改變仍有制度限制。不過，部分共和黨議員，尤其來自搖擺州者，可能在資料中心、環境及監管等議題上與民主黨合作。
企業高層也可能主動調整與白宮的互動，避免過於親近的形象引發反效果。川普原本以鬆綁監管爭取企業支持，但《CNBC》認為，選民情緒與國會權力變化，可能讓政策朝相反方向移動。
對科技股而言，這篇分析提出的風險是：黃仁勳個人的危機，可能進一步改變整個產業與政府互動的方式。其影響範圍，將取決於國會調查、立法進度，以及企業如何回應新的政治環境。
paras_en: Jensen Huang’s departure from Nvidia (NVDA-US) could have repercussions that extend far beyond the company itself. CNBC analysis notes that, with Democrats scoring a sweeping victory in the U.S. midterm elections and voter frustration with corruption and cronyism on the rise, the close ties between tech firms and the White House may come under stricter scrutiny, potentially shifting regulatory policy from deregulation to tighter controls.

For investors, the next watch‑points include not only Nvidia’s succession plan and operating outlook, but also chip export rules, AI legislation and data‑center policies. The previous model in which senior executives leveraged personal connections to directly shape policy could now become a new political risk.

Voters angry about the close nexus of politics and business put Huang’s saga in the spotlight. A CNBC poll shows that 90% of respondents consider corruption a key or major factor in their voting decisions, edging out cost‑of‑living concerns by one percentage point. When asked which party is better equipped to tackle corruption, 37% favor Democrats versus 30% for Republicans, while 32% say neither party can handle it.

Another pre‑election survey found that 93% of respondents oppose elected officials such as the president or members of Congress personally holding or trading stocks of companies that have contracts with the federal government, and 89% oppose members of the president’s family receiving government contracts, reflecting bipartisan voter concerns about conflicts of interest.

CNBC argues that the Huang episode hits these sensitive issues head‑on. Nvidia and other large corporations have donated to Trump’s “Hall of Fame” construction project, while the government faces accusations of failing to act appropriately after learning that Nvidia chips might have been illegally shipped to China.

Analysts point out that whether the Trump administration ignored internal warnings and allowed Huang to travel to China and take part in chip‑export policy discussions will be a focal point for external scrutiny. However, the allegations cannot yet be equated with proven illegal conduct or confirmed quid‑pro‑quo exchanges.

Congress may tighten tech oversight, prompting a reassessment of corporate‑White House relations. Senator Warren has signaled a push for stronger regulation, urging Congress to pass bipartisan bills such as the AI Overwatch Act to prevent advanced U.S. AI technology from flowing to China. She warned that the nation cannot rely on billionaire CEOs of big tech to place national security above profit.

CNBC analysis suggests that policy shifts could start with companies keeping a clearer distance from politics, reducing direct business influence on legislation. If public pressure continues to rise, broader regulatory adjustments could follow. The post‑financial‑crisis tightening of banking regulations is cited as a historical example of public dissatisfaction driving policy change, though it does not guarantee the tech sector will experience the same outcome.

Even with Democrats gaining a sizable majority in both chambers, they may still lack the votes needed to override a presidential veto, so institutional checks will limit how quickly policies can change. Nonetheless, some Republican lawmakers, especially those from swing states, might cooperate with Democrats on issues like data centers, the environment and regulation.

Corporate leaders may also proactively modify their interactions with the White House to avoid the perception of being overly cozy, which could backfire. Trump originally pursued deregulation to win corporate support, but CNBC believes that shifting voter sentiment and congressional power could push policy in the opposite direction.

For tech stocks, the analysis flags a risk that Huang’s personal crisis could reshape how the industry engages with government overall. The ultimate impact will depend on congressional investigations, legislative progress, and how companies adapt to the new political landscape.

items.title: 有錢也難搶？Anthropic IPO傳擋中港資金 認購需求達6倍
items.title_en: Even With Money, It's Hard to Grab? Anthropic IPO Faces Hurdles for Mainland China and Hong Kong Investors, Subscription Demand Hits 6‑Times
paras: AI新股熱潮碰上地緣政治門檻。據外媒周五(13日)引述知情人士報導，Claude開發商Anthropic的首次公開發行(IPO)，傳出中國與香港機構投資人的申購受阻。即使近期AI股大幅震盪，這筆交易仍吸引大量買盤，潛在投資人的認購意向約為可供出售股數的6倍。
Anthropic預計11月18日定價、19日掛牌，在那斯達克全球精選市場以「ANT」為股票代號交易。公司與共同創辦人擬透過IPO及私募合計籌資最高904億美元，估值上看1.4兆美元，由高盛(GS-US)與摩根士丹利(MS-US)領銜承銷。

認購熱度高 中港機構卻傳難獲配售

知情人士表示，部分銀行已拒絕接受中國與香港機構投資人的訂單，或認為這些投資人即使申購，也不太可能取得配售。部分限制與美國規範國防產品交易的《國際武器貿易條例》(ITAR)有關。
不過，各銀行的處理方式並不一致。部分管道仍允許客戶提交訂單，最終能否分配到股票，仍取決於發行人決定。換言之，「可以下單」不代表「能夠獲配」。
這並非大型科技IPO首度出現類似限制。知情人士指出，SpaceX先前規模862億美元的IPO，也曾要求承銷商不接受中國與香港投資人的訂單，但兩地投資人在股票掛牌後仍可買進。Anthropic上市後是否採取相同安排，目前尚未明朗。
部分投資人正嘗試透過境外持股架構等方式參與，但能否成功取得配售仍不確定。Anthropic、高盛與摩根士丹利均未對相關消息置評。

1.4兆美元估值受矚目 台灣未列明示發售市場

值得注意的是，Anthropic上市文件並未明列針對中國與香港投資人的銷售限制，相關限制主要透過承銷溝通傳達，使這場熱門IPO的申購資格更受關注。
公司列出的發售市場包括美國、澳洲、加拿大、部分歐洲經濟區成員國、日本、瑞士與英國，台灣未在這份明示名單中。不過，文件也允許承銷安排機構在其他國家提供股票，因此不能僅憑名單判定台灣投資人完全無法參與；能否申購與獲配，仍須視實際發售安排而定。
這筆交易正值美中AI競爭升溫。Anthropic在公開說明書中，將美國政府加強檢視AI企業與中國國家行為者的接觸，以及美中緊張關係升高，列為營運風險。其產品目前也未在中國與香港提供服務。
即使上周AI相關股票遭遇猛烈拋售，Anthropic的IPO熱度仍持續升高，部分既有支持者甚至向新投資人提供部分配售額度。不過，約6倍的認購意向反映的是目前申購興趣，並不等同最終訂單或上市後的股價表現。
paras_en: AI IPO frenzy meets geopolitical hurdles. According to foreign media quoting insiders on Friday the 13th, Anthropic, the developer of Claude, is facing reports that institutional investors from China and Hong Kong are being blocked from subscribing to its initial public offering. Even though AI stocks have been highly volatile lately, the deal is still attracting strong buying interest, with potential investors expressing subscription intent roughly six times the number of shares on offer.

Anthropic plans to price on November 18 and list on November 19, trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker "ANT". The company and its co‑founders aim to raise up to $90.4 billion through the IPO and a private placement, valuing the firm at about $1.4 trillion, with Goldman Sachs (GS‑US) and Morgan Stanley (MS‑US) leading the underwriting syndicate.

Subscription enthusiasm is high, but Chinese and Hong Kong institutions are reportedly finding it hard to get allocations. Insiders say some banks have refused to accept orders from these investors or believe that even if orders are placed, allocations are unlikely. The restrictions are linked in part to the U.S. International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), which governs defense‑related product transactions.

However, banks are not handling the issue uniformly. Some channels still allow clients to submit orders, but whether the shares are ultimately allocated depends on the issuer’s decision. In other words, being able to place an order does not guarantee an allocation.

This is not the first time a large‑tech IPO has faced similar constraints. Insiders note that SpaceX’s previously planned $86.2 billion IPO also required underwriters to reject orders from Chinese and Hong Kong investors, though those investors were still able to buy shares after the stock began trading. It remains unclear whether Anthropic will adopt the same approach after its listing.

Some investors are trying to participate via offshore holding structures, but it is uncertain whether they will secure allocations. Anthropic, Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley have not commented on the reports.

The $1.4 trillion valuation has drawn attention, and Taiwan is not explicitly listed as a selling market. Notably, Anthropic’s prospectus does not expressly state sales restrictions for China and Hong Kong investors; the limitations are conveyed mainly through underwriting communications, making eligibility for this hot IPO a focal point.

The prospectus lists the offering markets as the United States, Australia, Canada, certain Euro‑area member states, Japan, Switzerland and the United Kingdom, with Taiwan absent from the explicit list. However, the document also permits underwriters to make the shares available in other countries, so a simple list cannot be used to conclude that Taiwanese investors are completely excluded; eligibility and allocation will depend on the actual distribution arrangements.

The transaction comes amid heightened U.S.–China AI competition. Anthropic’s filing cites increased U.S. government scrutiny of AI firms’ interactions with Chinese state actors and rising U.S.–China tensions as operational risks. Its products are currently not offered in China or Hong Kong.

Even after last week’s sharp sell‑off in AI‑related stocks, interest in Anthropic’s IPO remains strong, with some existing supporters offering portions of their allocations to new investors. However, the roughly six‑fold subscription interest reflects current demand and does not equate to final order sizes or post‑listing share performance.

items.title: 以後買東西只要交代AI？ChatGPT推代付款 每筆仍須本人點頭
paras: OpenAI周五(13日)宣布推出ChatGPT Wallet支付功能，讓旗下AI代理「dots」能代替使用者付款購物，首波僅開放美國境內年滿18歲、持有符合資格美國發行卡片的ChatGPT Pro訂閱用戶使用。每筆交易仍須由使用者確認，並透過臉部辨識或指紋等安全驗證核准，AI代理不會取得使用者的實際信用卡資料。
這項功能由OpenAI與美國運通(AXP-US)、萬事達卡(MA-US)及Visa(V-US)合作打造，首波開放給美國境內年滿18歲、持有符合資格美國發行卡片的ChatGPT Pro訂閱用戶，既有信用卡回饋與保障也可保留。

每筆交易須本人核准 AI代理透過代碼付款

符合資格的使用者只需輸入一次卡片資料，之後便可要求dots尋找想購買的商品。付款前，使用者能檢視商品、總金額與選用卡片，再透過Face ID或指紋辨識等方式核准交易。
OpenAI表示，支付網路會提供「支付代碼」，內含限於特定交易使用的卡號、安全碼與到期日，取代實際信用卡資訊。因此，商家與AI代理都不會看見使用者的真實卡片資料。
初期仍採逐筆核准，但OpenAI預期，未來使用者可在設定金額上限、商品類別或授權期間等條件後，將購物任務交由代理執行。
OpenAI商業化與支付產品主管Chaya Nayak接受《CNBC》訪問時表示，目前重點是與商家及支付網路夥伴合作，建立安全、容易使用的基礎。她指出，當使用者找到真正想買的商品，OpenAI希望能協助他們完成最後的購買步驟。

初期不抽交易佣金 商家接受度成發展關鍵

ChatGPT Wallet未來可能為OpenAI開闢新收入來源，但公司表示，推出初期不會從交易中抽成，而是先建立商家關係，擴大ChatGPT作為購物平台的角色。
OpenAI過去一年持續投入AI購物服務，但早期嘗試並非都順利。公司去年秋季推出「Instant Checkout」即時結帳功能後，很快調整方向，今年3月再推出改版購物體驗，著重協助使用者搜尋與比較商品。Nayak表示，新錢包功能正是建立在這些商品探索服務之上。
美國運通執行副總裁暨全球創新主管Luke Gebb指出，先在有限範圍推出，是確認功能正常運作的適當方式。據報導，截至第三季底，ChatGPT每周活躍用戶已超過12億，付費用戶接近1億，龐大使用者基礎也讓OpenAI未來具備擴大服務規模的空間。
不過，AI代理代購仍面臨商家端的限制。聯合航空(UAL-US)周三表示，將阻止代理存取其系統訂票；亞馬遜(AMZN-US)也禁止代理在其平台代購商品，意味著錢包上線並不代表能在所有網站使用。
OpenAI坦言，AI代理購物仍處於早期階段，並同步發布工具與指引，協助商家避免網站意外封鎖其代理。Nayak表示，整個產業仍需要時間建立適當基礎設施，才能讓跨網站購物體驗更加流暢。

items.title: 輝達恐寫14年最長連跌！一周市值蒸發6572億美元 下周財報能止血？
items.title_en: Nvidia Faces Potential 14-Year Longest Weekly Decline as Market Value Erases $657.2 Billion; Can Next Week's Earnings Stem the Bleeding?
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)股價持續承壓，本周迄今下跌14.4%，恐連續第六周收黑，寫下14年來最長周線連跌紀錄，單周市值已蒸發約6,572億美元。隨著公司下周二公布財報，市場除了關注業績，也將檢視庫藏股動作、執行長接班安排，以及與台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)等關鍵合作夥伴的關係能否維持穩定。
據《MarketWatch》報導，輝達面臨的賣壓早於黃仁勳醜聞曝光。市場對AI支出能否持續、新興雲端業者財務狀況，以及政治環境可能拖慢資料中心建設的疑慮，都讓股價承壓。黃仁勳因婚外情爭議突然辭任，又為公司前景增添不確定性。

費半上漲輝達卻重挫 財報與庫藏股成止跌觀察點

根據道瓊市場數據，若輝達本周收低，將追平2012年10月結束的六周連跌紀錄。本周市值縮水規模，也可能創下公司史上最大單周紀錄。
相較之下，費城半導體指數本周上漲5.6%，輝達落後約20個百分點，為2008年以來最大差距，顯示其本周表現明顯弱於整體晶片族群。
下一項考驗是下周二公布的截至10月季度財報。擔任財務長逾十年的克瑞斯(Colette Kress)，目前暫代執行長，市場將關注她如何說明公司營運與後續方向。
分析師也在觀察，輝達是否會透過大規模買回股票支撐股價。截至9月底，公司尚有2,350億美元的股票回購授權額度。不過，授權額度不代表已承諾投入，實際買回規模與速度仍待管理層說明。

接班不只換執行長 台積電合作與人才留任受矚目

TD Cowen分析師Joshua Buchalter領軍的團隊指出，黃仁勳離職留下的空缺，並非僅靠財務領導即可填補。除了克瑞斯，公司還需要具有明確技術與營運權威的領導者，未來可能形成不同於一般企業的領導架構。
分析師認為，接班人選將決定輝達未來方向，可能類似蘋果(AAPL-US)從重視願景的賈伯斯，交棒給更擅長營運管理的庫克。
對台灣投資人而言，重要觀察點是輝達與客戶、供應商的關係，尤其是台積電。TD Cowen指出，若出現客戶或供應商轉向其他合作對象，將是局勢尚未穩定的明確訊號；但這是分析師提出的風險指標，並非已有合作生變的消息。
此外，輝達對AI產業的投資布局是否調整，以及誰能接替黃仁勳成為AI發展最具影響力的倡議者，也存在疑問。分析師表示，目前尚不清楚相關投資有多少可能需要撤回。
在AI人才競爭激烈之際，輝達能否留住關鍵主管與工程師，同樣牽動後續表現。TD Cowen認為，重要人才的去留與公司的留才決策，都將成為影響股價的因素。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) shares have remained under pressure, down 14.4% so far this week, risking a sixth consecutive week of losses and potentially setting a 14-year record for the longest weekly losing streak, with about $657.2 billion of market value evaporated in a single week. With the company set to release its earnings next Tuesday, the market will not only focus on the results but also scrutinize the share‑repurchase program, the CEO succession plan, and whether key partnerships with firms such as TSMC (2330‑TW, TSM‑US) remain stable.

According to MarketWatch, the selling pressure on Nvidia began before the Jensen Huang scandal broke. Concerns over whether AI spending can be sustained, the financial health of emerging cloud players, and a political environment that could slow data‑center construction have all weighed on the stock. Huang’s sudden resignation amid an extramarital affair controversy adds further uncertainty to the company’s outlook.
The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rose while Nvidia plunged, making earnings and share‑repurchase activity the key points to watch for a potential bottom.

Based on Dow Jones market data, if Nvidia closes lower this week it will match a six‑week losing streak that ended in October 2012. The scale of this week’s market‑cap shrinkage could also become the largest single‑week decline in the company’s history.

In contrast, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index gained 5.6% this week, leaving Nvidia lagging by roughly 20 percentage points – the widest gap since 2008 – highlighting that Nvidia’s performance has been markedly weaker than the broader chip sector.

The next test comes with the quarterly earnings due next Tuesday for the quarter ending October. Colette Kress, who has served as CFO for over a decade and is currently acting CEO, will be under the spotlight as the market watches how she explains the company’s operations and future direction.

Analysts are also watching whether Nvidia will support the stock with a large‑scale buyback. As of the end of September, the company still has $235 billion of share‑repurchase authorization remaining. However, the authorization does not represent a committed spend, and the actual size and pace of any buyback will depend on management’s guidance.

Succession is about more than just a new CEO; the partnership with TSMC and talent retention are also in focus. TD Cowen analyst Joshua Buchalter’s team notes that Huang’s departure leaves a void that cannot be filled by financial leadership alone. In addition to Kress, Nvidia will need a leader with clear technical and operational authority, potentially resulting in a governance structure unlike that of typical companies.
Analysts believe the choice of successor will shape Nvidia’s future path, perhaps resembling Apple’s transition from visionary Steve Jobs to operations‑focused Tim Cook.

For Taiwanese investors, a key watchpoint is Nvidia’s relationships with its customers and suppliers, especially TSMC. TD Cowen points out that any shift of customers or suppliers to other partners would signal an unstable situation; however, this is a risk indicator raised by analysts, not evidence of an actual change in collaborations.

Furthermore, questions remain about whether Nvidia will adjust its AI‑industry investment strategy and who will succeed Huang as the most influential advocate for AI development. Analysts say it is unclear how much of the current AI‑related investment might need to be withdrawn.

Amid fierce competition for AI talent, Nvidia’s ability to retain key executives and engineers also ties directly to its future performance. TD Cowen believes that the retention or loss of critical talent and the company’s broader talent‑retention policies will be factors influencing the stock price.

items.title: 誰接黃仁勳？輝達傳找上老戰友 安謀執行長哈斯入列
items.title_en: Who Will Succeed Jensen Huang? Nvidia Said to Approach Old Ally, Arm CEO Rene Haas
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)尋找黃仁勳接班人傳出新進展。《金融時報》周五(13日)引述知情人士報導，輝達董事會已接觸安謀(Arm)(ARM-US)執行長哈斯(Rene Haas)，評估由這位曾在輝達任職約七年的老將接掌公司。不過，哈斯只是多名候選人之一，目前尚未確定是否會獲邀出任，或是否願意接受職務。
哈斯自2022年起領導這家由軟銀(9984-JP)支持的英國晶片設計公司。他在十多年前曾任職輝達，期間受到黃仁勳指導，2013年轉赴安謀後，至今仍與黃仁勳及部分輝達董事保持密切關係。
報導指出，哈斯被視為少數可能接掌輝達的外部人選之一，另一人是主要競爭對手超微(AMD-US)執行長蘇姿丰。內部候選人則包括目前暫代執行長的財務長克瑞斯(Colette Kress)，以及資料中心業務主管Ian Buck。不過，報導並未指稱輝達董事會已接觸蘇姿丰。
黃仁勳周四宣布辭職，結束長達33年的掌舵生涯。此前曝光的婚外情爭議涉及至少一名部屬，以及一名遭美國情報機構懷疑具有中國間諜身分的女性客戶，使這家市值約4兆美元、位居AI產業核心的晶片巨頭陷入領導危機。
除了由克瑞斯暫代執行長，輝達也任命自1993年公司創立以來便擔任董事的瓊斯(Harvey Jones)，出任公司首位董事長。董事會正試圖穩定局面，同時監督由一名前聯邦檢察官主持、針對黃仁勳行為展開的獨立調查。
尋找接班人對輝達而言是一項重大挑戰。黃仁勳過去高度集中掌握公司決策，並在部分員工與投資人之間擁有極高的個人號召力。隨著他突然離職，公司治理與管理方式也受到更嚴格檢視。
哈斯與輝達的淵源，還延伸至兩家公司過去的併購布局。輝達2020年曾提出以400億美元收購安謀，但交易後來因監管疑慮告吹。安謀的矽智財技術支撐全球多數智慧手機晶片，也應用於輝達的AI硬體。
不過，雙方的關係也出現競爭色彩。安謀今年推出自家的完整AI晶片，使這家長期以技術授權為核心的公司，開始直接與客戶競爭。
此外，哈斯與軟銀執行長孫正義同樣關係密切。孫正義正試圖打造能與輝達抗衡的AI事業版圖，哈斯也在今年4月獲任命領導軟銀國際業務。這些職務與合作關係，使他的下一步格外受到關注，但接班安排仍未定案。
安謀拒絕評論相關消息，輝達則未立即回應置評請求。
稍早接班消息傳出後，安謀美國上市股票跌幅收斂，但當時仍下跌逾5%；輝達股價則下跌逾3%。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) is reportedly making new progress in its search for a successor to Jensen Huang. The Financial Times on Friday the 13th quoted sources saying the Nvidia board has reached out to Arm (ARM-US) CEO Rene Haas to assess whether the veteran who spent about seven years at Nvidia could take the helm. Haas is just one of several candidates and it is not yet clear whether he will be invited or willing to accept the role.

Haas has led the UK chip‑design firm backed by SoftBank (9984-JP) since 2022. Over a decade ago he worked at Nvidia, where he was mentored by Huang, and after moving to Arm in 2013 he has remained in close contact with Huang and several Nvidia directors.

The report says Haas is seen as one of the few external candidates who could run Nvidia, with the other being AMD (AMD-US) CEO Lisa Su. Internal candidates include the interim CEO and CFO Colette Kress and data‑center head Ian Buck. The article does not say the board has contacted Su.

Huang announced on Thursday that he will step down, ending a 33‑year tenure at the helm. Earlier revelations of an extramarital affair involving at least one subordinate and a female client suspected by U.S. intelligence of being a Chinese spy have plunged the roughly $4 trillion‑valued AI‑chip giant into a leadership crisis.

In addition to Kress serving as interim CEO, Nvidia has appointed long‑time director Harvey Jones, who has been on the board since the company’s founding in 1993, as its first chairman. The board is trying to steady the ship while overseeing an independent probe into Huang’s conduct led by a former federal prosecutor.

Finding a successor is a major challenge for Nvidia. Huang has long held concentrated decision‑making power and wielded huge personal influence among employees and investors. His sudden departure puts the company’s governance and management under tighter scrutiny.

Haas’s ties to Nvidia also stretch back to past merger talks. In 2020 Nvidia proposed a $40 billion acquisition of Arm, but the deal fell apart over regulatory concerns. Arm’s silicon‑intellectual‑property technology underpins most smartphone chips and is used in Nvidia’s AI hardware.

However, the relationship has also taken on a competitive edge. This year Arm launched its own full AI chip, moving the firm, traditionally focused on technology licensing, into direct competition with customers.

Haas is also close to SoftBank CEO Masayoshi Son, who is trying to build an AI business that can rival Nvidia. Haas was appointed to lead SoftBank’s international operations in April, and these roles and partnerships have drawn extra attention to his next move, though the succession plan remains undecided.
Arm declined to comment on the reports, and Nvidia did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
After the succession news broke, Arm’s U.S.-listed shares narrowed their decline but were still down more than 5 %; Nvidia’s stock fell more than 3 %.

items.title: 蘋果、Google都走過創辦人交棒！為何輝達接班更難？
items.title_en: Apple and Google Have Both Seen Founders Step Down—Why Is Nvidia’s Succession Even Harder?
paras: 蘋果、Google與優步(Uber)都曾經歷創辦人退出經營第一線，但輝達(NVDA-US)面臨的接班考驗可能更加艱鉅。據《CNBC》報導，黃仁勳突然辭任執行長，讓接班人不僅得處理醜聞衝擊，還必須接手他長年主導的組織運作、供應鏈與政商關係，在AI競爭加劇之際維持公司優勢。
黃仁勳周四因多起婚外情報導引發的爭議離職，其中涉及一名遭美方懷疑與中國情報活動有關的女子。目前由財務長克瑞斯(Colette Kress)暫代執行長，董事會正尋找正式接班人。
美國聖母大學門多薩商學院管理學教授Michael Withers表示，全球最大企業之一的創辦人兼執行長，在醜聞中如此突然離職，情況相當罕見。繼任者面臨的挑戰，將遠超過一般創辦人交棒。

蘋果與Google交棒有準備 輝達突陷接班考驗

蘋果(AAPL-US)創辦人賈伯斯2011年辭任時，公司形象同樣與他密不可分，但蘋果過去已有其他執行長，也具備準備多時的內部接班人庫克。
Withers指出，庫克接任前已累積相當充分的準備。他以供應鏈管理見長，上任後推動晶片策略與服務業務，也成為蘋果與美中政府往來的重要代表。庫克掌舵15年間，蘋果市值從約3,500億美元成長至4兆美元。
Google共同創辦人佩吉與布林則於2019年退出Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)經營第一線，交棒安排早有預期。佩吉當時稱，那是簡化管理架構的自然時機；此後在皮查伊領導下，Alphabet股價累計上漲逾300%。
優步(UBER-US)共同創辦人卡蘭尼克2017年因連串醜聞與公司治理問題，在壓力下離職，情況與輝達較為接近。不過，Withers指出，優步危機歷經數月發酵，與輝達如今面臨的局面仍有差異。接任的科斯洛沙希隨後整頓組織，帶領公司走向獲利。
相較之下，黃仁勳在輝達掌舵33年，個人領導風格深入公司運作。他採取扁平化管理，直屬部屬多達60人，透過快速溝通減少層層管理。Withers認為，輝達看來並未為黃仁勳準備好接班計畫，使這次突如其來的轉換更加棘手。

接班不只接產品 政商關係與供應鏈都是考題

Withers表示，即使在正常情況下，接替創辦人的執行長也得兼顧延續成功模式與建立自身領導方式。如今繼任者還必須走出黃仁勳的影子，並處理個人醜聞可能持續對公司造成的影響。
另一項難以直接交接的資產，是黃仁勳建立的人脈。他與美國總統川普關係密切，今年5月曾隨同訪中，也持續爭取放寬對中國的晶片出口限制。在供應鏈端，他與SK海力士(SKHY-US)、三星電子(005930-KS)等關鍵供應商高層同樣保持緊密往來。
持有輝達股票的Liontrust資產管理公司全球創新團隊共同主管Storm Uru指出，調整企業文化與管理供應鏈，是接班人的兩項優先任務。黃仁勳過去能提出未來願景，促使供應商共同投入、擴大產能；在供應鏈已相當吃緊的情況下，這項能力尤其重要。
與此同時，超微(AMD-US)等競爭對手，以及積極開發自有晶片的大型雲端業者，也持續對輝達形成壓力。
不過，部分投資人認為，輝達未來數年的產品路線圖並未因黃仁勳離職而改變。Advisors Capital Management合夥人暨投資組合經理Joanne Feeney提醒，評估公司前景仍須看向黃仁勳以外的團隊，輝達背後還有成千上萬名工程師，持續支撐技術與產品開發。
paras_en: Apple, Google and Uber have all experienced founders exiting day‑to‑day operations, but Nvidia (NVDA-US) faces an even more daunting succession challenge. According to CNBC, Jensen Huang’s sudden resignation as CEO forces a successor to not only deal with the fallout of a scandal but also take over the organization, supply chain and government‑business relationships he has long overseen, while maintaining the company’s edge amid intensifying AI competition.

Huang resigned on Thursday amid multiple controversies involving extramarital affairs, including a woman suspected by U.S. authorities of ties to Chinese intelligence activities. Finance chief Colette Kress is currently acting as CEO while the board searches for a permanent replacement.

Michael Withers, a professor of management at the Mendoza College of Business, University of Notre Dame, said it is extremely rare for a founder‑CEO of one of the world’s largest companies to depart so abruptly amid a scandal. The challenges facing the heir will far exceed those of a typical founder hand‑over.
Apple and Google prepared for their transitions, while Nvidia is suddenly thrust into a succession test.

When Tim Cook took over, he had already amassed considerable preparation. Known for his supply‑chain expertise, he pushed Apple’s chip strategy and services business after taking the helm and became a key liaison between Apple and the U.S. and Chinese governments. Over his 15‑year tenure, Apple’s market value grew from roughly $350 billion to $4 trillion.

Google co‑founders Larry Page and Sergey Brin stepped away from Alphabet (GOOGL-US/GOOG-US) in 2019 with a well‑planned hand‑over. Page said it was a natural time to simplify the management structure; under Sundar Pichai’s leadership, Alphabet’s stock has since risen more than 300%.

Uber co‑founder Travis Kalanick left in 2017 under pressure from a series of scandals and governance issues, a situation more akin to Nvidia’s. However, Withers notes that Uber’s crisis unfolded over months, differing from Nvidia’s current sudden scenario. Successor Dara Khosrowshahi subsequently reorganized the company and steered it back to profitability.

By contrast, Huang has led Nvidia for 33 years, embedding his personal leadership style throughout the firm. He employed a flat hierarchy with up to 60 direct reports, using rapid communication to cut layers of management. Withers believes Nvidia appears to have had no succession plan for Huang, making this abrupt transition especially tricky.
A successor must inherit not only products but also political‑business relationships and supply‑chain management, both of which are critical test items.

Withers adds that an intangible asset difficult to hand over is Huang’s network. He has close ties to former President Donald Trump, traveled to China with him in May, and continues to lobby for relaxed U.S. chip‑export restrictions to China. On the supply‑chain side, he maintains close contacts with senior executives at key suppliers such as SK Hynix (SKHY-US) and Samsung Electronics (005930‑KS).

Storm Uru, co‑head of the Global Innovation team at Liontrust Asset Management, which holds Nvidia shares, said reshaping corporate culture and managing the supply chain are the successor’s top priorities. Huang’s ability to articulate a future vision that rallied suppliers to expand capacity was especially vital given the already tight supply chain.
Meanwhile, competitors such as AMD (AMD-US) and large cloud providers developing their own chips continue to pressure Nvidia.

Nevertheless, some investors argue that Nvidia’s product roadmap for the next few years remains unchanged despite Huang’s departure. Joanne Feeney, partner and portfolio manager at Advisors Capital Management, cautions that the company’s outlook should be judged beyond Huang, noting that thousands of engineers behind Nvidia will keep driving technology and product development.

items.title: 「別只看後照鏡！」美財長喊話Fed：別因能源衝擊升息
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)周五(13日)表示，聯準會(Fed)應保持開放態度，不應因伊朗戰爭引發的能源供給衝擊而升息。他認為，美國經濟基本面依然強勁，而能源衝擊正逐漸緩和，決策官員應著眼未來，避免對雜訊較多的數據反應過度。
貝森特接受《CNBC》訪問時表示，Fed應理解，目前面臨的是能源供給衝擊。在這股衝擊減弱之際，若仍過度升息，並非合適做法。
貝森特說：「Fed應該看向未來，而不是盯著後照鏡。」
上周公布的美國就業報告優於預期，強化了Fed進一步升息的理由。此前，期中選舉後的股市賣壓，以及市場擔憂AI相關需求轉弱可能拖累經濟，曾使升息預期有所降溫。
Fed上月維持政策利率不變，主席華許(Kevin Warsh)當時表示，決策官員將觀察後續數據，以判斷是否需要進一步收緊貨幣政策。
貝森特強調：「我不會告訴Fed該怎麼做，我要說的是，他們應該保持開放態度。」
他並指出，Fed去年同期曾三度降息，如今若僅因能源供給衝擊，就大幅轉向緊縮，並不是他會支持的政策選擇。
「如果我在Fed，我不會這麼做，但我不在Fed。」貝森特說。他的發言也凸顯，對於能源價格推升的通膨壓力應如何因應，財政部長與支持進一步緊縮政策的立場之間，存在不同看法。

items.title: 材料-KY布局購併進行中 1-9月每股賺進1.85元
paras: 材料-KY(4763-TW)2026年下半年來營收已站穩10億元大關，公司今(13)日公布最新財報獲利資訊，材料-KY在2026年第三季營收回升到31.23億元，毛利率也回升到48%，季增7.11個百分點，但因自中國大陸匯出資金扣繳稅款達9.63億元影響，導致單季近損益兩平，2026年1-3季稅後純益18.29億元，每股純益1.85元。
展現跨區域、多元化發展的強大企圖心的材料-KY指出，對2026年第四季營收展望持審慎樂觀看法，將持續關注客戶庫存、終端需求與全球貿易環境，彈性調整營運步調，並依規劃推進Cerdia交易相關作業，深化全球布局與產品組合，提升長期競爭力。
材料-KY2026年第三季營收31.23億元，毛利率48%，季增7.11個百分點，年減12.33個百分點，本期淨利爲951萬元，歸屬母公司小虧204萬元，趨近於損益兩平。
材料-KY2026年1-9月營收86.78億元，毛利率48.04%，年減10.77個百分點，稅後純益18.29億元，年減62.56%，每股純益1.85元。
2026年第三季材料-KY營收為31.23億元，較去年同期成長27.6%，較前季成長9.8%。主要係下游客戶經過一年以上的庫存調整，整體產業庫存水位已逐步回歸正常區間，回補庫存需求帶動第三季營收成長。同時，第三季毛利率回升，主要係第二季受部分子公司擴大歲修範圍影響而推升單位成本。相關影響消退後，第三季合併毛利率由前季的40.9%回升至48.%，增加7.11個百分點。
2026年第三季材料-KY營業淨利為12.41億元，較前季成長27.8%。第三季營業費用率為8.2%，較前季6.7%增加1.5個百分點。費用上升主要係2026年第三季在「傳統出貨旺季、供應鏈繞道導致的運力吃緊、港口壅塞」等因素持續發酵下，整體海運費較第二季上漲，加上第三季透過海運外銷出口的占比提高，推升推銷費用。
2026年第三季材料-KY的本期淨利951萬元，較前季大幅減少，主要因進行併購需求，第三季中國大陸子公司盈餘匯出，依法扣繳相應稅款3,035萬美元，折合約新台幣9.63億元，這一次性稅務影響數，導致第三季稅後純益較第二季下滑，並不影響本業實質營運體質。公司將持續推動成本優化與營運韌性提升計畫，以掌握市場需求回補機會，穩固在醋酸纖維產業的領先地位及核心獲利能力。
材料-KY對第四季營收展望持審慎樂觀看法，將持續關注客戶庫存、終端需求與全球貿易環境，彈性調整營運步調，並依規劃推進Cerdia交易相關作業，深化全球布局與產品組合，提升長期競爭力。
材料-KY在2026年10月營收爲10.52億元，爲今年單月次高，月增2.69%，年增33.07%，1-10月營收97.29億元，年減13.53%。

材料-KY在全球布局方面，材料-KY已於2026年9月21日宣布，董事會通過與黑石集團（Blackstone）旗下管理基金簽署股份購買協議及股份交換契約，擬以現金及股票對價取得Cerdia Holding 100%股權。Cerdia擁有逾百年纖維素材料製造經驗，全球員工約1,100人，並於歐洲及美洲設有生產基地。待交易完成後，濟南大自然新材料營運據點將由中國延伸至德國、美國、巴西及俄羅斯，涵蓋亞洲、歐洲、北美洲與南美洲。公司預期，結合雙方生產據點、客戶基礎與研發能力，將有助提升生產調度、原料配置及客戶服務彈性，強化因應關稅、物流及地緣政治變化的能力。

items.title: 26億資金活水注入  力晶投控未上市股流動性勁揚
paras: 力晶創新投資控股公司(力晶投控)未上市股票流動性再添助力，除本公司實行庫藏股、山一投資公開購買股份，合計總額20億元股權外，鈺創、晶豪科等友好企業也先後宣布各以3億元向特定人洽購或直接在未上市的市場購買等方式，長期投資力晶投控股權。這一波總計26億元的購買股權行動，為未上市股票市場資金池注入可觀活水。
力晶投控透露，總額10億元的庫藏股公開收購計畫，已進入最後核算階段，預計將可在20日以每股42元將所有購股款項匯入合格交易股東的帳戶。山一投資的總額10億元、每股40-45元的公開購買也獲得力晶投控股東的熱烈響應，即將在16日截止。
有意售股的力晶投控股東，可趕在截止登記前至山一投資登記售股意願。據先前承辦單位公告，山ㄧ投資公司將於12月4日把股款匯入合格交易的股東帳戶。
據了解，力晶投控友好廠商鈺創、晶豪科相繼宣布總額各3億元的購買股票計畫，有別於力晶投控的庫藏股以及山一投資採公開購買方式，鈺創與晶豪科旗下的晶湛投資公司都將先洽有出售意願的特定人購買股份，其他餘額部分則會在未上市股票市場管道買入。
力晶投控表示，有正式提交出售意願書的股東，如果沒有趕上庫藏股或山一投資公開購買計畫，該公司也將在詢問相關股東意願後，轉介其他友好廠商評估，以利有意願出售的股東，也有機會依洽特定人的管道進行股份交易。

items.title: 羅昇機器人大腦打入國際頂級品牌供應鏈 累計出貨破千套
paras: 佳世達(2352-TW)旗下羅昇(8374-TW)今(13)日舉行法說，總經理李長堅表示，今年「機器人大腦」已打入國際頂級機器人品牌供應鏈，海外累計出貨突破數千套，展望2027年，將持續深耕半導體、機器人與智慧物流等關鍵領域，擴大高附加價值產品及系統整合比重，強化長期成長動能。
李長堅表示，先進機器人搭載的AI運算平台「機器人大腦」，須具備高算力、低延遲的環境感知與即時決策能力，才能支援複雜工廠及倉儲環境中的自主導航。羅昇從前期開發驗證、客戶規格適配，到量產備料與供應鏈調度，協助客戶縮短開發及量產導入時程，目前累計出貨已突破數千套。
除機器人大腦外，羅昇也持續投入機器人動力控制模組、感測模組及次系統核心技術研發，今年推出機器人關節模組，協助客戶克服從設計驗證到量產階段的技術及供應鏈挑戰，加速AI技術轉化為商用機器人產品。
半導體方面，羅昇持續整合運動控制、驅動、運算、感測、電源、節能系統及流體等關鍵技術，並與專精矽晶圓及玻璃載板再生清洗的華矽創新(USIC)深化合作，協助先進製程客戶降低成本與碳排放，擴大半導體供應鏈布局。
智慧物流方面，羅昇進一步整合怡進(TRANSPAK)的包裝設備技術，共同推進AI微型倉儲、自動化包裝及堆拆棧方案，並結合AI 3D機器視覺檢測與數據管理平台，加速智慧物流應用落地。
羅昇前三季營收達44.42億元，年增36.21%，創歷史同期新高，毛利率維持24.61%，每股純益1.39元，李長堅表示，羅昇正從產品供應商進一步朝技術整合與次系統方案發展，並透過佳世達集團「AI解決方案與智慧製造」的跨企業協作，複製成熟技術與場域經驗，提升高毛利產品及解決方案比重。

items.title: 信立Q3受惠本業+業外挹注 獲利季增近3倍爆量成長
paras: 信立化學(4303-TW)受惠本業營運動能持續提升，加上業外認列轉投資金融評價利益挹注，第3季稅後純益為9,487萬元、季增3.66倍，稅後盈餘(EPS)達0.72元也較上季成長，累計今(2026)年前3季合併營收達9.17億元，稅後純益7,010萬元，EPS達0.53元。
信立表示，第3季營運表現亮眼，受惠持續拓展鞋材、包材、運動用品及機能材料等多元應用市場，高附加價值合成皮革、機能性膜材與特殊效果材料出貨增加，帶動整體產品組合持續優化；
另信立推動營運轉型，深化母公司永捷(4714-TW)、子公司普大應用材料及邁達康(9960-TW)之間的策略聯盟，透過垂直與水平資源整合，從上游PU樹脂配方、機能膜材研發、合成皮革貼合加工，到終端運動用品及多元應用市場，逐步擴大集團整體業務綜效，包括第3季毛利率達25％，季增4個百分點，營業利益率達4％，在高附加價值產品出貨成長及營運效率持續改善下，帶動本業獲利能力。
信立10月營收達1.37億元、年增96.66％，續創歷年同期新高，累計今年1至10月合併營收達10.54億元、年增23.97％，亦刷新歷年同期記錄。
信立10月營收成長，受惠國際運動品牌持續推進新品上市、復刻鞋款及節慶檔期備貨需求，高附加價值合成皮革、機能性膜材與特殊效果材料出貨維持良好動能，加上子公司邁達康旗下電商通路客戶拉貨而同步回升，亦為10月營收增添成長動能，帶動信立整體業務表現持續向上。
展望未來今年第4季，信立持審慎樂觀看法。隨著國際運動品牌持續推進秋冬新品、節慶檔期及下一年度鞋款開發，有助延續高附加價值合成皮革、輕量化PU Film與特殊效果材料的市場需求，信立也將持續深化永捷、普大應材及邁達康之間的策略聯盟，結合上游材料研發、中游加工製程與下游品牌及通路資源，加速新材料開發驗證與市場應用。

items.title: 永捷麻豆廠明年Q3起生產環保材料訂單 Q3獲利虧轉盈
paras: 永捷(4714-TW)第3季稅後純益1,557萬元，EPS為0.07元，較上季轉虧為盈，累計今(2026)年前3季合稅後淨損217萬元，每股稅後淨損-0.01元。永捷表示，第3季受惠國際運動品牌新品上市及備貨需求增溫，帶動高機能、環保型鞋材訂單出貨增加，也帶動單季毛利率提升至26％水準。
永捷第3季合併營收達5.4億元，季減4％、年增40％，創歷年同期新高；單季稅後純益1,557萬元、EPS為0.07元。永捷甫公告10月營收達1.72億元、年增72.12％，續創歷年同期新高，累計今年前10月合併營收達18.96億元、年增63.54％，也刷新歷年同期新高。
永捷指出，受惠國際運動品牌持續推進新品開發與年終銷售備貨，高機能鞋材、環保型PU樹脂及特殊材料出貨需求維持良好，加上集團材料垂直整合效益逐步發揮，進一步擴大整體營收規模，也展現多元業務布局成果。

永捷表示，看好全球品牌供應鏈對環保永續材料的重視程度持續提升，尤其歐盟針對PFHxA及相關物質的限制規範逐步實施，促使鞋類及相關材料供應鏈加速尋求符合環保法規的替代方案，帶動無氟塗層、低溶劑及可追溯材料的開發需求，公司持續推進水性PU、高固含量、無溶劑產品及無氟抗刮耐磨助劑等技術開發，積極掌握國際品牌對材料性能、環保規範及供應鏈管理的多重要求，並透過高附加價值產品組合優化，強化全球環保永續材料市場競爭優勢。
此外，為因應海外環保材料訂單需求，永捷積極推進麻豆廠公共危險物品倉庫建置，提升化學原物料安全備貨及供應調度能力，持續進行反應槽擴建工程，規劃於明(2027)年第3季投入生產，以擴充聚酯多元醇產能，支應歐洲、日本及印度等海外市場業務拓展。
展望第4季，永捷持審慎樂觀看法，將持續深化綠色環保材料、高機能鞋材業務，亦積極布局新世代電子材料，投入可撓式硬塗層(Hard Coat，HC)技術開發，掌握折疊式顯示裝置對輕薄、耐磨及高可靠度材料的需求，拓展高附加價值應用商機，同步完善集團垂直水平資源整合綜效，以期帶動未來營運良好成長動能。

items.title: 美聯邦航空總署下令「全美航班暫停起飛」
items.title_en: U.S. Federal Aviation Administration Orders Nationwide Flight Halt
paras: 美國聯邦航空總署 (FAA) 週五 (13 日) 下午發布全國性地面停飛令前，芝加哥地區已傳出航管通訊異常，部分飛往芝加哥歐海爾(Chicago O"Hare International Airport) 及中途機場的航班被要求留在出發地。
FAA 隨後以「特殊情況」及飛安考量為由，要求全美尚未起飛的離港航班暫停起飛，飛往美國的國際航班則逐案處理。
截至台灣時間週六 (14 日) 清晨5時20分許，FAA 尚未證實芝加哥的通訊異常是否與全國停飛有關，停飛令是否解除也尚待確認。
回顧歷史，全美地面停飛實屬相當罕見。
上一次發生的時間點是 2023 年 1 月 11 日，FAA 的飛航通告 (NOTAM) 系統故障，影響機組員取得跑道關閉、臨時空域限制等飛安資訊。FAA 因此下令全美航班暫停起飛，約一個半小時後解除，但當天仍有約 9,000 班航班延誤、1,300 班取消。
FAA 事後查明，承包商人員在處理主資料庫與備份資料庫的同步問題時，意外刪除檔案。
再往前一次是 2001 年 9 月 11 日。
兩架遭劫持的客機先後撞上紐約世界貿易中心雙塔後，FAA 於美東時間上午約 9 時 25 分下令全美民航機停止起飛，並於上午 9 時 45 分要求已在空中的航班儘速在最近的機場降落。
當時有逾 4,500 架飛機在空中。到了中午約 12 時 15 分，美國本土 48 州上空的商用及私人航班已全數降落。這是美國史上首次因突發事件關閉全國民航空域。
paras_en: Before the FAA issued a nationwide ground stop on Friday (the 13th) in the afternoon, abnormal air‑traffic communications were reported in the Chicago area, and some flights bound for Chicago O'Hare International Airport and intermediate airports were instructed to remain at their departure points.

The FAA then, citing “special circumstances” and flight‑safety considerations, ordered all U.S. departures that had not yet taken off to pause, while inbound international flights to the United States would be handled on a case‑by‑case basis.

As of about 5:20 a.m. Taiwan time on Saturday (the 14th), the FAA had not confirmed whether the Chicago communications issue was related to the nationwide halt, and it had not yet announced when the stop order would be lifted.
Historically, a nationwide ground halt in the United States is extremely rare.

The last occurrence was on January 11 2023, when a failure in the FAA’s NOTAM system prevented crews from receiving runway‑closure and temporary airspace‑restriction information. The FAA ordered a nationwide flight pause, which was lifted about an hour and a half later, but that day still saw roughly 9,000 delayed flights and 1,300 cancellations.
The FAA later determined that a contractor accidentally deleted files while addressing a synchronization issue between the primary and backup databases.
The previous nationwide halt was on September 11 2001.

After the two hijacked aircraft struck the World Trade Center towers, the FAA ordered all civil aviation in the United States to stop taking off at about 9:25 a.m. Eastern Time and, at 9:45 a.m., instructed flights already in the air to land at the nearest airport as quickly as possible.

At that time more than 4,500 aircraft were airborne. By roughly 12:15 p.m., all commercial and private flights over the contiguous 48 states had landed, marking the first time in U.S. history that the entire national airspace was closed due to an emergency.

items.title: 黃仁勳下台後 科技巨頭與白宮的「好交情」恐變燙手山芋
items.title_en: After Jensen Huang Steps Down, the ‘Good Relationship’ Between Tech Giants and the White House May Turn Into a Hot Potato
paras: 黃仁勳離開輝達(NVDA-US)後，衝擊可能不只停留在公司內部。《CNBC》分析指出，隨著民主黨在美國期中選舉大勝，加上選民對貪腐與政商關係的不滿升高，科技企業與白宮的密切往來可能面臨更嚴格檢視，甚至推動監管政策從鬆綁轉向收緊。
對投資人而言，接下來的觀察重點，除了輝達接班與營運前景，也包括晶片出口、AI立法及資料中心政策是否改變。企業過去透過高層人脈直接參與政策討論的模式，可能成為新的政治風險。

選民不滿政商過從甚密 黃仁勳風波成焦點

《CNBC》選民調查顯示，90%受訪者認為貪腐是影響投票決定的關鍵或重大議題，比生活成本高出1個百分點。至於哪個政黨更有能力處理貪腐，民主黨以37%領先共和黨的30%，但也有32%認為兩黨都不行。
選前另一項調查則顯示，93%受訪者反對總統與國會議員等民選官員，個人持有或交易與聯邦政府簽約公司的股票；89%反對總統家族成員取得政府合約，反映跨黨派選民對利益衝突的疑慮。
《CNBC》認為，黃仁勳事件正好觸及這些敏感問題。輝達與其他大型企業曾向川普的宴會廳建設計畫捐款；另一方面，政府也面臨指控，被質疑在獲悉輝達晶片可能非法流向中國後，未採取適當行動。
分析指出，川普政府是否忽視內部警訊，仍讓黃仁勳隨行訪中並參與晶片出口政策討論，將成為外界追問的焦點。不過，相關質疑尚不能直接等同違法或利益交換已獲證實。

國會可能加強科技監管 企業與白宮關係面臨重估

參議員華倫已釋出強化監管訊號，主張國會應通過《AI Overwatch Act》等跨黨派法案，防止美國先進AI技術流入中國。她表示，不能仰賴大型科技公司的億萬富豪執行長，自行將國家安全置於獲利之上。
《CNBC》分析，政策變化可能先從企業與政治保持更清楚距離開始，減少商界對政策的直接影響；若民意壓力持續升高，也可能演變為更廣泛的監管調整。金融海嘯後銀行業受到更嚴格規範，就是公眾不滿推動政策轉向的歷史例子，但不代表科技業必然重演相同情況。
即使民主黨在國會兩院取得大幅優勢，也未必具備推翻總統否決所需的票數，因此政策改變仍有制度限制。不過，部分共和黨議員，尤其來自搖擺州者，可能在資料中心、環境及監管等議題上與民主黨合作。
企業高層也可能主動調整與白宮的互動，避免過於親近的形象引發反效果。川普原本以鬆綁監管爭取企業支持，但《CNBC》認為，選民情緒與國會權力變化，可能讓政策朝相反方向移動。
對科技股而言，這篇分析提出的風險是：黃仁勳個人的危機，可能進一步改變整個產業與政府互動的方式。其影響範圍，將取決於國會調查、立法進度，以及企業如何回應新的政治環境。
paras_en: Jensen Huang’s departure from Nvidia (NVDA-US) could have repercussions that extend far beyond the company itself. CNBC analysis notes that, with Democrats scoring a sweeping victory in the U.S. midterm elections and voter frustration with corruption and cronyism on the rise, the close ties between tech firms and the White House may come under stricter scrutiny, potentially shifting regulatory policy from deregulation to tighter controls.

For investors, the next watch‑points include not only Nvidia’s succession plan and operating outlook, but also chip export rules, AI legislation and data‑center policies. The previous model in which senior executives leveraged personal connections to directly shape policy could now become a new political risk.

Voters angry about the close nexus of politics and business put Huang’s saga in the spotlight. A CNBC poll shows that 90% of respondents consider corruption a key or major factor in their voting decisions, edging out cost‑of‑living concerns by one percentage point. When asked which party is better equipped to tackle corruption, 37% favor Democrats versus 30% for Republicans, while 32% say neither party can handle it.

Another pre‑election survey found that 93% of respondents oppose elected officials such as the president or members of Congress personally holding or trading stocks of companies that have contracts with the federal government, and 89% oppose members of the president’s family receiving government contracts, reflecting bipartisan voter concerns about conflicts of interest.

CNBC argues that the Huang episode hits these sensitive issues head‑on. Nvidia and other large corporations have donated to Trump’s “Hall of Fame” construction project, while the government faces accusations of failing to act appropriately after learning that Nvidia chips might have been illegally shipped to China.

Analysts point out that whether the Trump administration ignored internal warnings and allowed Huang to travel to China and take part in chip‑export policy discussions will be a focal point for external scrutiny. However, the allegations cannot yet be equated with proven illegal conduct or confirmed quid‑pro‑quo exchanges.

Congress may tighten tech oversight, prompting a reassessment of corporate‑White House relations. Senator Warren has signaled a push for stronger regulation, urging Congress to pass bipartisan bills such as the AI Overwatch Act to prevent advanced U.S. AI technology from flowing to China. She warned that the nation cannot rely on billionaire CEOs of big tech to place national security above profit.

CNBC analysis suggests that policy shifts could start with companies keeping a clearer distance from politics, reducing direct business influence on legislation. If public pressure continues to rise, broader regulatory adjustments could follow. The post‑financial‑crisis tightening of banking regulations is cited as a historical example of public dissatisfaction driving policy change, though it does not guarantee the tech sector will experience the same outcome.

Even with Democrats gaining a sizable majority in both chambers, they may still lack the votes needed to override a presidential veto, so institutional checks will limit how quickly policies can change. Nonetheless, some Republican lawmakers, especially those from swing states, might cooperate with Democrats on issues like data centers, the environment and regulation.

Corporate leaders may also proactively modify their interactions with the White House to avoid the perception of being overly cozy, which could backfire. Trump originally pursued deregulation to win corporate support, but CNBC believes that shifting voter sentiment and congressional power could push policy in the opposite direction.

For tech stocks, the analysis flags a risk that Huang’s personal crisis could reshape how the industry engages with government overall. The ultimate impact will depend on congressional investigations, legislative progress, and how companies adapt to the new political landscape.

items.title: 有錢也難搶？Anthropic IPO傳擋中港資金 認購需求達6倍
items.title_en: Even With Money, It's Hard to Grab? Anthropic IPO Faces Hurdles for Mainland China and Hong Kong Investors, Subscription Demand Hits 6‑Times
paras: AI新股熱潮碰上地緣政治門檻。據外媒周五(13日)引述知情人士報導，Claude開發商Anthropic的首次公開發行(IPO)，傳出中國與香港機構投資人的申購受阻。即使近期AI股大幅震盪，這筆交易仍吸引大量買盤，潛在投資人的認購意向約為可供出售股數的6倍。
Anthropic預計11月18日定價、19日掛牌，在那斯達克全球精選市場以「ANT」為股票代號交易。公司與共同創辦人擬透過IPO及私募合計籌資最高904億美元，估值上看1.4兆美元，由高盛(GS-US)與摩根士丹利(MS-US)領銜承銷。

認購熱度高 中港機構卻傳難獲配售

知情人士表示，部分銀行已拒絕接受中國與香港機構投資人的訂單，或認為這些投資人即使申購，也不太可能取得配售。部分限制與美國規範國防產品交易的《國際武器貿易條例》(ITAR)有關。
不過，各銀行的處理方式並不一致。部分管道仍允許客戶提交訂單，最終能否分配到股票，仍取決於發行人決定。換言之，「可以下單」不代表「能夠獲配」。
這並非大型科技IPO首度出現類似限制。知情人士指出，SpaceX先前規模862億美元的IPO，也曾要求承銷商不接受中國與香港投資人的訂單，但兩地投資人在股票掛牌後仍可買進。Anthropic上市後是否採取相同安排，目前尚未明朗。
部分投資人正嘗試透過境外持股架構等方式參與，但能否成功取得配售仍不確定。Anthropic、高盛與摩根士丹利均未對相關消息置評。

1.4兆美元估值受矚目 台灣未列明示發售市場

值得注意的是，Anthropic上市文件並未明列針對中國與香港投資人的銷售限制，相關限制主要透過承銷溝通傳達，使這場熱門IPO的申購資格更受關注。
公司列出的發售市場包括美國、澳洲、加拿大、部分歐洲經濟區成員國、日本、瑞士與英國，台灣未在這份明示名單中。不過，文件也允許承銷安排機構在其他國家提供股票，因此不能僅憑名單判定台灣投資人完全無法參與；能否申購與獲配，仍須視實際發售安排而定。
這筆交易正值美中AI競爭升溫。Anthropic在公開說明書中，將美國政府加強檢視AI企業與中國國家行為者的接觸，以及美中緊張關係升高，列為營運風險。其產品目前也未在中國與香港提供服務。
即使上周AI相關股票遭遇猛烈拋售，Anthropic的IPO熱度仍持續升高，部分既有支持者甚至向新投資人提供部分配售額度。不過，約6倍的認購意向反映的是目前申購興趣，並不等同最終訂單或上市後的股價表現。
paras_en: AI IPO frenzy meets geopolitical hurdles. According to foreign media quoting insiders on Friday the 13th, Anthropic, the developer of Claude, is facing reports that institutional investors from China and Hong Kong are being blocked from subscribing to its initial public offering. Even though AI stocks have been highly volatile lately, the deal is still attracting strong buying interest, with potential investors expressing subscription intent roughly six times the number of shares on offer.

Anthropic plans to price on November 18 and list on November 19, trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker "ANT". The company and its co‑founders aim to raise up to $90.4 billion through the IPO and a private placement, valuing the firm at about $1.4 trillion, with Goldman Sachs (GS‑US) and Morgan Stanley (MS‑US) leading the underwriting syndicate.

Subscription enthusiasm is high, but Chinese and Hong Kong institutions are reportedly finding it hard to get allocations. Insiders say some banks have refused to accept orders from these investors or believe that even if orders are placed, allocations are unlikely. The restrictions are linked in part to the U.S. International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), which governs defense‑related product transactions.

However, banks are not handling the issue uniformly. Some channels still allow clients to submit orders, but whether the shares are ultimately allocated depends on the issuer’s decision. In other words, being able to place an order does not guarantee an allocation.

This is not the first time a large‑tech IPO has faced similar constraints. Insiders note that SpaceX’s previously planned $86.2 billion IPO also required underwriters to reject orders from Chinese and Hong Kong investors, though those investors were still able to buy shares after the stock began trading. It remains unclear whether Anthropic will adopt the same approach after its listing.

Some investors are trying to participate via offshore holding structures, but it is uncertain whether they will secure allocations. Anthropic, Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley have not commented on the reports.

The $1.4 trillion valuation has drawn attention, and Taiwan is not explicitly listed as a selling market. Notably, Anthropic’s prospectus does not expressly state sales restrictions for China and Hong Kong investors; the limitations are conveyed mainly through underwriting communications, making eligibility for this hot IPO a focal point.

The prospectus lists the offering markets as the United States, Australia, Canada, certain Euro‑area member states, Japan, Switzerland and the United Kingdom, with Taiwan absent from the explicit list. However, the document also permits underwriters to make the shares available in other countries, so a simple list cannot be used to conclude that Taiwanese investors are completely excluded; eligibility and allocation will depend on the actual distribution arrangements.

The transaction comes amid heightened U.S.–China AI competition. Anthropic’s filing cites increased U.S. government scrutiny of AI firms’ interactions with Chinese state actors and rising U.S.–China tensions as operational risks. Its products are currently not offered in China or Hong Kong.

Even after last week’s sharp sell‑off in AI‑related stocks, interest in Anthropic’s IPO remains strong, with some existing supporters offering portions of their allocations to new investors. However, the roughly six‑fold subscription interest reflects current demand and does not equate to final order sizes or post‑listing share performance.

items.title: 以後買東西只要交代AI？ChatGPT推代付款 每筆仍須本人點頭
paras: OpenAI周五(13日)宣布推出ChatGPT Wallet支付功能，讓旗下AI代理「dots」能代替使用者付款購物，首波僅開放美國境內年滿18歲、持有符合資格美國發行卡片的ChatGPT Pro訂閱用戶使用。每筆交易仍須由使用者確認，並透過臉部辨識或指紋等安全驗證核准，AI代理不會取得使用者的實際信用卡資料。
這項功能由OpenAI與美國運通(AXP-US)、萬事達卡(MA-US)及Visa(V-US)合作打造，首波開放給美國境內年滿18歲、持有符合資格美國發行卡片的ChatGPT Pro訂閱用戶，既有信用卡回饋與保障也可保留。

每筆交易須本人核准 AI代理透過代碼付款

符合資格的使用者只需輸入一次卡片資料，之後便可要求dots尋找想購買的商品。付款前，使用者能檢視商品、總金額與選用卡片，再透過Face ID或指紋辨識等方式核准交易。
OpenAI表示，支付網路會提供「支付代碼」，內含限於特定交易使用的卡號、安全碼與到期日，取代實際信用卡資訊。因此，商家與AI代理都不會看見使用者的真實卡片資料。
初期仍採逐筆核准，但OpenAI預期，未來使用者可在設定金額上限、商品類別或授權期間等條件後，將購物任務交由代理執行。
OpenAI商業化與支付產品主管Chaya Nayak接受《CNBC》訪問時表示，目前重點是與商家及支付網路夥伴合作，建立安全、容易使用的基礎。她指出，當使用者找到真正想買的商品，OpenAI希望能協助他們完成最後的購買步驟。

初期不抽交易佣金 商家接受度成發展關鍵

ChatGPT Wallet未來可能為OpenAI開闢新收入來源，但公司表示，推出初期不會從交易中抽成，而是先建立商家關係，擴大ChatGPT作為購物平台的角色。
OpenAI過去一年持續投入AI購物服務，但早期嘗試並非都順利。公司去年秋季推出「Instant Checkout」即時結帳功能後，很快調整方向，今年3月再推出改版購物體驗，著重協助使用者搜尋與比較商品。Nayak表示，新錢包功能正是建立在這些商品探索服務之上。
美國運通執行副總裁暨全球創新主管Luke Gebb指出，先在有限範圍推出，是確認功能正常運作的適當方式。據報導，截至第三季底，ChatGPT每周活躍用戶已超過12億，付費用戶接近1億，龐大使用者基礎也讓OpenAI未來具備擴大服務規模的空間。
不過，AI代理代購仍面臨商家端的限制。聯合航空(UAL-US)周三表示，將阻止代理存取其系統訂票；亞馬遜(AMZN-US)也禁止代理在其平台代購商品，意味著錢包上線並不代表能在所有網站使用。
OpenAI坦言，AI代理購物仍處於早期階段，並同步發布工具與指引，協助商家避免網站意外封鎖其代理。Nayak表示，整個產業仍需要時間建立適當基礎設施，才能讓跨網站購物體驗更加流暢。

items.title: 輝達恐寫14年最長連跌！一周市值蒸發6572億美元 下周財報能止血？
items.title_en: Nvidia Faces Potential 14-Year Longest Weekly Decline as Market Value Erases $657.2 Billion; Can Next Week's Earnings Stem the Bleeding?
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)股價持續承壓，本周迄今下跌14.4%，恐連續第六周收黑，寫下14年來最長周線連跌紀錄，單周市值已蒸發約6,572億美元。隨著公司下周二公布財報，市場除了關注業績，也將檢視庫藏股動作、執行長接班安排，以及與台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)等關鍵合作夥伴的關係能否維持穩定。
據《MarketWatch》報導，輝達面臨的賣壓早於黃仁勳醜聞曝光。市場對AI支出能否持續、新興雲端業者財務狀況，以及政治環境可能拖慢資料中心建設的疑慮，都讓股價承壓。黃仁勳因婚外情爭議突然辭任，又為公司前景增添不確定性。

費半上漲輝達卻重挫 財報與庫藏股成止跌觀察點

根據道瓊市場數據，若輝達本周收低，將追平2012年10月結束的六周連跌紀錄。本周市值縮水規模，也可能創下公司史上最大單周紀錄。
相較之下，費城半導體指數本周上漲5.6%，輝達落後約20個百分點，為2008年以來最大差距，顯示其本周表現明顯弱於整體晶片族群。
下一項考驗是下周二公布的截至10月季度財報。擔任財務長逾十年的克瑞斯(Colette Kress)，目前暫代執行長，市場將關注她如何說明公司營運與後續方向。
分析師也在觀察，輝達是否會透過大規模買回股票支撐股價。截至9月底，公司尚有2,350億美元的股票回購授權額度。不過，授權額度不代表已承諾投入，實際買回規模與速度仍待管理層說明。

接班不只換執行長 台積電合作與人才留任受矚目

TD Cowen分析師Joshua Buchalter領軍的團隊指出，黃仁勳離職留下的空缺，並非僅靠財務領導即可填補。除了克瑞斯，公司還需要具有明確技術與營運權威的領導者，未來可能形成不同於一般企業的領導架構。
分析師認為，接班人選將決定輝達未來方向，可能類似蘋果(AAPL-US)從重視願景的賈伯斯，交棒給更擅長營運管理的庫克。
對台灣投資人而言，重要觀察點是輝達與客戶、供應商的關係，尤其是台積電。TD Cowen指出，若出現客戶或供應商轉向其他合作對象，將是局勢尚未穩定的明確訊號；但這是分析師提出的風險指標，並非已有合作生變的消息。
此外，輝達對AI產業的投資布局是否調整，以及誰能接替黃仁勳成為AI發展最具影響力的倡議者，也存在疑問。分析師表示，目前尚不清楚相關投資有多少可能需要撤回。
在AI人才競爭激烈之際，輝達能否留住關鍵主管與工程師，同樣牽動後續表現。TD Cowen認為，重要人才的去留與公司的留才決策，都將成為影響股價的因素。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) shares have remained under pressure, down 14.4% so far this week, risking a sixth consecutive week of losses and potentially setting a 14-year record for the longest weekly losing streak, with about $657.2 billion of market value evaporated in a single week. With the company set to release its earnings next Tuesday, the market will not only focus on the results but also scrutinize the share‑repurchase program, the CEO succession plan, and whether key partnerships with firms such as TSMC (2330‑TW, TSM‑US) remain stable.

According to MarketWatch, the selling pressure on Nvidia began before the Jensen Huang scandal broke. Concerns over whether AI spending can be sustained, the financial health of emerging cloud players, and a political environment that could slow data‑center construction have all weighed on the stock. Huang’s sudden resignation amid an extramarital affair controversy adds further uncertainty to the company’s outlook.
The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rose while Nvidia plunged, making earnings and share‑repurchase activity the key points to watch for a potential bottom.

Based on Dow Jones market data, if Nvidia closes lower this week it will match a six‑week losing streak that ended in October 2012. The scale of this week’s market‑cap shrinkage could also become the largest single‑week decline in the company’s history.

In contrast, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index gained 5.6% this week, leaving Nvidia lagging by roughly 20 percentage points – the widest gap since 2008 – highlighting that Nvidia’s performance has been markedly weaker than the broader chip sector.

The next test comes with the quarterly earnings due next Tuesday for the quarter ending October. Colette Kress, who has served as CFO for over a decade and is currently acting CEO, will be under the spotlight as the market watches how she explains the company’s operations and future direction.

Analysts are also watching whether Nvidia will support the stock with a large‑scale buyback. As of the end of September, the company still has $235 billion of share‑repurchase authorization remaining. However, the authorization does not represent a committed spend, and the actual size and pace of any buyback will depend on management’s guidance.

Succession is about more than just a new CEO; the partnership with TSMC and talent retention are also in focus. TD Cowen analyst Joshua Buchalter’s team notes that Huang’s departure leaves a void that cannot be filled by financial leadership alone. In addition to Kress, Nvidia will need a leader with clear technical and operational authority, potentially resulting in a governance structure unlike that of typical companies.
Analysts believe the choice of successor will shape Nvidia’s future path, perhaps resembling Apple’s transition from visionary Steve Jobs to operations‑focused Tim Cook.

For Taiwanese investors, a key watchpoint is Nvidia’s relationships with its customers and suppliers, especially TSMC. TD Cowen points out that any shift of customers or suppliers to other partners would signal an unstable situation; however, this is a risk indicator raised by analysts, not evidence of an actual change in collaborations.

Furthermore, questions remain about whether Nvidia will adjust its AI‑industry investment strategy and who will succeed Huang as the most influential advocate for AI development. Analysts say it is unclear how much of the current AI‑related investment might need to be withdrawn.

Amid fierce competition for AI talent, Nvidia’s ability to retain key executives and engineers also ties directly to its future performance. TD Cowen believes that the retention or loss of critical talent and the company’s broader talent‑retention policies will be factors influencing the stock price.

items.title: 誰接黃仁勳？輝達傳找上老戰友 安謀執行長哈斯入列
items.title_en: Who Will Succeed Jensen Huang? Nvidia Said to Approach Old Ally, Arm CEO Rene Haas
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)尋找黃仁勳接班人傳出新進展。《金融時報》周五(13日)引述知情人士報導，輝達董事會已接觸安謀(Arm)(ARM-US)執行長哈斯(Rene Haas)，評估由這位曾在輝達任職約七年的老將接掌公司。不過，哈斯只是多名候選人之一，目前尚未確定是否會獲邀出任，或是否願意接受職務。
哈斯自2022年起領導這家由軟銀(9984-JP)支持的英國晶片設計公司。他在十多年前曾任職輝達，期間受到黃仁勳指導，2013年轉赴安謀後，至今仍與黃仁勳及部分輝達董事保持密切關係。
報導指出，哈斯被視為少數可能接掌輝達的外部人選之一，另一人是主要競爭對手超微(AMD-US)執行長蘇姿丰。內部候選人則包括目前暫代執行長的財務長克瑞斯(Colette Kress)，以及資料中心業務主管Ian Buck。不過，報導並未指稱輝達董事會已接觸蘇姿丰。
黃仁勳周四宣布辭職，結束長達33年的掌舵生涯。此前曝光的婚外情爭議涉及至少一名部屬，以及一名遭美國情報機構懷疑具有中國間諜身分的女性客戶，使這家市值約4兆美元、位居AI產業核心的晶片巨頭陷入領導危機。
除了由克瑞斯暫代執行長，輝達也任命自1993年公司創立以來便擔任董事的瓊斯(Harvey Jones)，出任公司首位董事長。董事會正試圖穩定局面，同時監督由一名前聯邦檢察官主持、針對黃仁勳行為展開的獨立調查。
尋找接班人對輝達而言是一項重大挑戰。黃仁勳過去高度集中掌握公司決策，並在部分員工與投資人之間擁有極高的個人號召力。隨著他突然離職，公司治理與管理方式也受到更嚴格檢視。
哈斯與輝達的淵源，還延伸至兩家公司過去的併購布局。輝達2020年曾提出以400億美元收購安謀，但交易後來因監管疑慮告吹。安謀的矽智財技術支撐全球多數智慧手機晶片，也應用於輝達的AI硬體。
不過，雙方的關係也出現競爭色彩。安謀今年推出自家的完整AI晶片，使這家長期以技術授權為核心的公司，開始直接與客戶競爭。
此外，哈斯與軟銀執行長孫正義同樣關係密切。孫正義正試圖打造能與輝達抗衡的AI事業版圖，哈斯也在今年4月獲任命領導軟銀國際業務。這些職務與合作關係，使他的下一步格外受到關注，但接班安排仍未定案。
安謀拒絕評論相關消息，輝達則未立即回應置評請求。
稍早接班消息傳出後，安謀美國上市股票跌幅收斂，但當時仍下跌逾5%；輝達股價則下跌逾3%。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) is reportedly making new progress in its search for a successor to Jensen Huang. The Financial Times on Friday the 13th quoted sources saying the Nvidia board has reached out to Arm (ARM-US) CEO Rene Haas to assess whether the veteran who spent about seven years at Nvidia could take the helm. Haas is just one of several candidates and it is not yet clear whether he will be invited or willing to accept the role.

Haas has led the UK chip‑design firm backed by SoftBank (9984-JP) since 2022. Over a decade ago he worked at Nvidia, where he was mentored by Huang, and after moving to Arm in 2013 he has remained in close contact with Huang and several Nvidia directors.

The report says Haas is seen as one of the few external candidates who could run Nvidia, with the other being AMD (AMD-US) CEO Lisa Su. Internal candidates include the interim CEO and CFO Colette Kress and data‑center head Ian Buck. The article does not say the board has contacted Su.

Huang announced on Thursday that he will step down, ending a 33‑year tenure at the helm. Earlier revelations of an extramarital affair involving at least one subordinate and a female client suspected by U.S. intelligence of being a Chinese spy have plunged the roughly $4 trillion‑valued AI‑chip giant into a leadership crisis.

In addition to Kress serving as interim CEO, Nvidia has appointed long‑time director Harvey Jones, who has been on the board since the company’s founding in 1993, as its first chairman. The board is trying to steady the ship while overseeing an independent probe into Huang’s conduct led by a former federal prosecutor.

Finding a successor is a major challenge for Nvidia. Huang has long held concentrated decision‑making power and wielded huge personal influence among employees and investors. His sudden departure puts the company’s governance and management under tighter scrutiny.

Haas’s ties to Nvidia also stretch back to past merger talks. In 2020 Nvidia proposed a $40 billion acquisition of Arm, but the deal fell apart over regulatory concerns. Arm’s silicon‑intellectual‑property technology underpins most smartphone chips and is used in Nvidia’s AI hardware.

However, the relationship has also taken on a competitive edge. This year Arm launched its own full AI chip, moving the firm, traditionally focused on technology licensing, into direct competition with customers.

Haas is also close to SoftBank CEO Masayoshi Son, who is trying to build an AI business that can rival Nvidia. Haas was appointed to lead SoftBank’s international operations in April, and these roles and partnerships have drawn extra attention to his next move, though the succession plan remains undecided.
Arm declined to comment on the reports, and Nvidia did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
After the succession news broke, Arm’s U.S.-listed shares narrowed their decline but were still down more than 5 %; Nvidia’s stock fell more than 3 %.

items.title: 蘋果、Google都走過創辦人交棒！為何輝達接班更難？
items.title_en: Apple and Google Have Both Seen Founders Step Down—Why Is Nvidia’s Succession Even Harder?
paras: 蘋果、Google與優步(Uber)都曾經歷創辦人退出經營第一線，但輝達(NVDA-US)面臨的接班考驗可能更加艱鉅。據《CNBC》報導，黃仁勳突然辭任執行長，讓接班人不僅得處理醜聞衝擊，還必須接手他長年主導的組織運作、供應鏈與政商關係，在AI競爭加劇之際維持公司優勢。
黃仁勳周四因多起婚外情報導引發的爭議離職，其中涉及一名遭美方懷疑與中國情報活動有關的女子。目前由財務長克瑞斯(Colette Kress)暫代執行長，董事會正尋找正式接班人。
美國聖母大學門多薩商學院管理學教授Michael Withers表示，全球最大企業之一的創辦人兼執行長，在醜聞中如此突然離職，情況相當罕見。繼任者面臨的挑戰，將遠超過一般創辦人交棒。

蘋果與Google交棒有準備 輝達突陷接班考驗

蘋果(AAPL-US)創辦人賈伯斯2011年辭任時，公司形象同樣與他密不可分，但蘋果過去已有其他執行長，也具備準備多時的內部接班人庫克。
Withers指出，庫克接任前已累積相當充分的準備。他以供應鏈管理見長，上任後推動晶片策略與服務業務，也成為蘋果與美中政府往來的重要代表。庫克掌舵15年間，蘋果市值從約3,500億美元成長至4兆美元。
Google共同創辦人佩吉與布林則於2019年退出Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)經營第一線，交棒安排早有預期。佩吉當時稱，那是簡化管理架構的自然時機；此後在皮查伊領導下，Alphabet股價累計上漲逾300%。
優步(UBER-US)共同創辦人卡蘭尼克2017年因連串醜聞與公司治理問題，在壓力下離職，情況與輝達較為接近。不過，Withers指出，優步危機歷經數月發酵，與輝達如今面臨的局面仍有差異。接任的科斯洛沙希隨後整頓組織，帶領公司走向獲利。
相較之下，黃仁勳在輝達掌舵33年，個人領導風格深入公司運作。他採取扁平化管理，直屬部屬多達60人，透過快速溝通減少層層管理。Withers認為，輝達看來並未為黃仁勳準備好接班計畫，使這次突如其來的轉換更加棘手。

接班不只接產品 政商關係與供應鏈都是考題

Withers表示，即使在正常情況下，接替創辦人的執行長也得兼顧延續成功模式與建立自身領導方式。如今繼任者還必須走出黃仁勳的影子，並處理個人醜聞可能持續對公司造成的影響。
另一項難以直接交接的資產，是黃仁勳建立的人脈。他與美國總統川普關係密切，今年5月曾隨同訪中，也持續爭取放寬對中國的晶片出口限制。在供應鏈端，他與SK海力士(SKHY-US)、三星電子(005930-KS)等關鍵供應商高層同樣保持緊密往來。
持有輝達股票的Liontrust資產管理公司全球創新團隊共同主管Storm Uru指出，調整企業文化與管理供應鏈，是接班人的兩項優先任務。黃仁勳過去能提出未來願景，促使供應商共同投入、擴大產能；在供應鏈已相當吃緊的情況下，這項能力尤其重要。
與此同時，超微(AMD-US)等競爭對手，以及積極開發自有晶片的大型雲端業者，也持續對輝達形成壓力。
不過，部分投資人認為，輝達未來數年的產品路線圖並未因黃仁勳離職而改變。Advisors Capital Management合夥人暨投資組合經理Joanne Feeney提醒，評估公司前景仍須看向黃仁勳以外的團隊，輝達背後還有成千上萬名工程師，持續支撐技術與產品開發。
paras_en: Apple, Google and Uber have all experienced founders exiting day‑to‑day operations, but Nvidia (NVDA-US) faces an even more daunting succession challenge. According to CNBC, Jensen Huang’s sudden resignation as CEO forces a successor to not only deal with the fallout of a scandal but also take over the organization, supply chain and government‑business relationships he has long overseen, while maintaining the company’s edge amid intensifying AI competition.

Huang resigned on Thursday amid multiple controversies involving extramarital affairs, including a woman suspected by U.S. authorities of ties to Chinese intelligence activities. Finance chief Colette Kress is currently acting as CEO while the board searches for a permanent replacement.

Michael Withers, a professor of management at the Mendoza College of Business, University of Notre Dame, said it is extremely rare for a founder‑CEO of one of the world’s largest companies to depart so abruptly amid a scandal. The challenges facing the heir will far exceed those of a typical founder hand‑over.
Apple and Google prepared for their transitions, while Nvidia is suddenly thrust into a succession test.

When Tim Cook took over, he had already amassed considerable preparation. Known for his supply‑chain expertise, he pushed Apple’s chip strategy and services business after taking the helm and became a key liaison between Apple and the U.S. and Chinese governments. Over his 15‑year tenure, Apple’s market value grew from roughly $350 billion to $4 trillion.

Google co‑founders Larry Page and Sergey Brin stepped away from Alphabet (GOOGL-US/GOOG-US) in 2019 with a well‑planned hand‑over. Page said it was a natural time to simplify the management structure; under Sundar Pichai’s leadership, Alphabet’s stock has since risen more than 300%.

Uber co‑founder Travis Kalanick left in 2017 under pressure from a series of scandals and governance issues, a situation more akin to Nvidia’s. However, Withers notes that Uber’s crisis unfolded over months, differing from Nvidia’s current sudden scenario. Successor Dara Khosrowshahi subsequently reorganized the company and steered it back to profitability.

By contrast, Huang has led Nvidia for 33 years, embedding his personal leadership style throughout the firm. He employed a flat hierarchy with up to 60 direct reports, using rapid communication to cut layers of management. Withers believes Nvidia appears to have had no succession plan for Huang, making this abrupt transition especially tricky.
A successor must inherit not only products but also political‑business relationships and supply‑chain management, both of which are critical test items.

Withers adds that an intangible asset difficult to hand over is Huang’s network. He has close ties to former President Donald Trump, traveled to China with him in May, and continues to lobby for relaxed U.S. chip‑export restrictions to China. On the supply‑chain side, he maintains close contacts with senior executives at key suppliers such as SK Hynix (SKHY-US) and Samsung Electronics (005930‑KS).

Storm Uru, co‑head of the Global Innovation team at Liontrust Asset Management, which holds Nvidia shares, said reshaping corporate culture and managing the supply chain are the successor’s top priorities. Huang’s ability to articulate a future vision that rallied suppliers to expand capacity was especially vital given the already tight supply chain.
Meanwhile, competitors such as AMD (AMD-US) and large cloud providers developing their own chips continue to pressure Nvidia.

Nevertheless, some investors argue that Nvidia’s product roadmap for the next few years remains unchanged despite Huang’s departure. Joanne Feeney, partner and portfolio manager at Advisors Capital Management, cautions that the company’s outlook should be judged beyond Huang, noting that thousands of engineers behind Nvidia will keep driving technology and product development.

items.title: 「別只看後照鏡！」美財長喊話Fed：別因能源衝擊升息
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)周五(13日)表示，聯準會(Fed)應保持開放態度，不應因伊朗戰爭引發的能源供給衝擊而升息。他認為，美國經濟基本面依然強勁，而能源衝擊正逐漸緩和，決策官員應著眼未來，避免對雜訊較多的數據反應過度。
貝森特接受《CNBC》訪問時表示，Fed應理解，目前面臨的是能源供給衝擊。在這股衝擊減弱之際，若仍過度升息，並非合適做法。
貝森特說：「Fed應該看向未來，而不是盯著後照鏡。」
上周公布的美國就業報告優於預期，強化了Fed進一步升息的理由。此前，期中選舉後的股市賣壓，以及市場擔憂AI相關需求轉弱可能拖累經濟，曾使升息預期有所降溫。
Fed上月維持政策利率不變，主席華許(Kevin Warsh)當時表示，決策官員將觀察後續數據，以判斷是否需要進一步收緊貨幣政策。
貝森特強調：「我不會告訴Fed該怎麼做，我要說的是，他們應該保持開放態度。」
他並指出，Fed去年同期曾三度降息，如今若僅因能源供給衝擊，就大幅轉向緊縮，並不是他會支持的政策選擇。
「如果我在Fed，我不會這麼做，但我不在Fed。」貝森特說。他的發言也凸顯，對於能源價格推升的通膨壓力應如何因應，財政部長與支持進一步緊縮政策的立場之間，存在不同看法。

items.title: 美聯邦航空總署下令「全美航班暫停起飛」
items.title_en: U.S. Federal Aviation Administration Orders Nationwide Flight Halt
paras: 美國聯邦航空總署 (FAA) 週五 (13 日) 下午發布全國性地面停飛令前，芝加哥地區已傳出航管通訊異常，部分飛往芝加哥歐海爾(Chicago O"Hare International Airport) 及中途機場的航班被要求留在出發地。
FAA 隨後以「特殊情況」及飛安考量為由，要求全美尚未起飛的離港航班暫停起飛，飛往美國的國際航班則逐案處理。
截至台灣時間週六 (14 日) 清晨5時20分許，FAA 尚未證實芝加哥的通訊異常是否與全國停飛有關，停飛令是否解除也尚待確認。
回顧歷史，全美地面停飛實屬相當罕見。
上一次發生的時間點是 2023 年 1 月 11 日，FAA 的飛航通告 (NOTAM) 系統故障，影響機組員取得跑道關閉、臨時空域限制等飛安資訊。FAA 因此下令全美航班暫停起飛，約一個半小時後解除，但當天仍有約 9,000 班航班延誤、1,300 班取消。
FAA 事後查明，承包商人員在處理主資料庫與備份資料庫的同步問題時，意外刪除檔案。
再往前一次是 2001 年 9 月 11 日。
兩架遭劫持的客機先後撞上紐約世界貿易中心雙塔後，FAA 於美東時間上午約 9 時 25 分下令全美民航機停止起飛，並於上午 9 時 45 分要求已在空中的航班儘速在最近的機場降落。
當時有逾 4,500 架飛機在空中。到了中午約 12 時 15 分，美國本土 48 州上空的商用及私人航班已全數降落。這是美國史上首次因突發事件關閉全國民航空域。
paras_en: Before the FAA issued a nationwide ground stop on Friday (the 13th) in the afternoon, abnormal air‑traffic communications were reported in the Chicago area, and some flights bound for Chicago O'Hare International Airport and intermediate airports were instructed to remain at their departure points.

The FAA then, citing “special circumstances” and flight‑safety considerations, ordered all U.S. departures that had not yet taken off to pause, while inbound international flights to the United States would be handled on a case‑by‑case basis.

As of about 5:20 a.m. Taiwan time on Saturday (the 14th), the FAA had not confirmed whether the Chicago communications issue was related to the nationwide halt, and it had not yet announced when the stop order would be lifted.
Historically, a nationwide ground halt in the United States is extremely rare.

The last occurrence was on January 11 2023, when a failure in the FAA’s NOTAM system prevented crews from receiving runway‑closure and temporary airspace‑restriction information. The FAA ordered a nationwide flight pause, which was lifted about an hour and a half later, but that day still saw roughly 9,000 delayed flights and 1,300 cancellations.
The FAA later determined that a contractor accidentally deleted files while addressing a synchronization issue between the primary and backup databases.
The previous nationwide halt was on September 11 2001.

After the two hijacked aircraft struck the World Trade Center towers, the FAA ordered all civil aviation in the United States to stop taking off at about 9:25 a.m. Eastern Time and, at 9:45 a.m., instructed flights already in the air to land at the nearest airport as quickly as possible.

At that time more than 4,500 aircraft were airborne. By roughly 12:15 p.m., all commercial and private flights over the contiguous 48 states had landed, marking the first time in U.S. history that the entire national airspace was closed due to an emergency.

items.title: 黃仁勳下台後 科技巨頭與白宮的「好交情」恐變燙手山芋
items.title_en: After Jensen Huang Steps Down, the ‘Good Relationship’ Between Tech Giants and the White House May Turn Into a Hot Potato
paras: 黃仁勳離開輝達(NVDA-US)後，衝擊可能不只停留在公司內部。《CNBC》分析指出，隨著民主黨在美國期中選舉大勝，加上選民對貪腐與政商關係的不滿升高，科技企業與白宮的密切往來可能面臨更嚴格檢視，甚至推動監管政策從鬆綁轉向收緊。
對投資人而言，接下來的觀察重點，除了輝達接班與營運前景，也包括晶片出口、AI立法及資料中心政策是否改變。企業過去透過高層人脈直接參與政策討論的模式，可能成為新的政治風險。

選民不滿政商過從甚密 黃仁勳風波成焦點

《CNBC》選民調查顯示，90%受訪者認為貪腐是影響投票決定的關鍵或重大議題，比生活成本高出1個百分點。至於哪個政黨更有能力處理貪腐，民主黨以37%領先共和黨的30%，但也有32%認為兩黨都不行。
選前另一項調查則顯示，93%受訪者反對總統與國會議員等民選官員，個人持有或交易與聯邦政府簽約公司的股票；89%反對總統家族成員取得政府合約，反映跨黨派選民對利益衝突的疑慮。
《CNBC》認為，黃仁勳事件正好觸及這些敏感問題。輝達與其他大型企業曾向川普的宴會廳建設計畫捐款；另一方面，政府也面臨指控，被質疑在獲悉輝達晶片可能非法流向中國後，未採取適當行動。
分析指出，川普政府是否忽視內部警訊，仍讓黃仁勳隨行訪中並參與晶片出口政策討論，將成為外界追問的焦點。不過，相關質疑尚不能直接等同違法或利益交換已獲證實。

國會可能加強科技監管 企業與白宮關係面臨重估

參議員華倫已釋出強化監管訊號，主張國會應通過《AI Overwatch Act》等跨黨派法案，防止美國先進AI技術流入中國。她表示，不能仰賴大型科技公司的億萬富豪執行長，自行將國家安全置於獲利之上。
《CNBC》分析，政策變化可能先從企業與政治保持更清楚距離開始，減少商界對政策的直接影響；若民意壓力持續升高，也可能演變為更廣泛的監管調整。金融海嘯後銀行業受到更嚴格規範，就是公眾不滿推動政策轉向的歷史例子，但不代表科技業必然重演相同情況。
即使民主黨在國會兩院取得大幅優勢，也未必具備推翻總統否決所需的票數，因此政策改變仍有制度限制。不過，部分共和黨議員，尤其來自搖擺州者，可能在資料中心、環境及監管等議題上與民主黨合作。
企業高層也可能主動調整與白宮的互動，避免過於親近的形象引發反效果。川普原本以鬆綁監管爭取企業支持，但《CNBC》認為，選民情緒與國會權力變化，可能讓政策朝相反方向移動。
對科技股而言，這篇分析提出的風險是：黃仁勳個人的危機，可能進一步改變整個產業與政府互動的方式。其影響範圍，將取決於國會調查、立法進度，以及企業如何回應新的政治環境。
paras_en: Jensen Huang’s departure from Nvidia (NVDA-US) could have repercussions that extend far beyond the company itself. CNBC analysis notes that, with Democrats scoring a sweeping victory in the U.S. midterm elections and voter frustration with corruption and cronyism on the rise, the close ties between tech firms and the White House may come under stricter scrutiny, potentially shifting regulatory policy from deregulation to tighter controls.

For investors, the next watch‑points include not only Nvidia’s succession plan and operating outlook, but also chip export rules, AI legislation and data‑center policies. The previous model in which senior executives leveraged personal connections to directly shape policy could now become a new political risk.

Voters angry about the close nexus of politics and business put Huang’s saga in the spotlight. A CNBC poll shows that 90% of respondents consider corruption a key or major factor in their voting decisions, edging out cost‑of‑living concerns by one percentage point. When asked which party is better equipped to tackle corruption, 37% favor Democrats versus 30% for Republicans, while 32% say neither party can handle it.

Another pre‑election survey found that 93% of respondents oppose elected officials such as the president or members of Congress personally holding or trading stocks of companies that have contracts with the federal government, and 89% oppose members of the president’s family receiving government contracts, reflecting bipartisan voter concerns about conflicts of interest.

CNBC argues that the Huang episode hits these sensitive issues head‑on. Nvidia and other large corporations have donated to Trump’s “Hall of Fame” construction project, while the government faces accusations of failing to act appropriately after learning that Nvidia chips might have been illegally shipped to China.

Analysts point out that whether the Trump administration ignored internal warnings and allowed Huang to travel to China and take part in chip‑export policy discussions will be a focal point for external scrutiny. However, the allegations cannot yet be equated with proven illegal conduct or confirmed quid‑pro‑quo exchanges.

Congress may tighten tech oversight, prompting a reassessment of corporate‑White House relations. Senator Warren has signaled a push for stronger regulation, urging Congress to pass bipartisan bills such as the AI Overwatch Act to prevent advanced U.S. AI technology from flowing to China. She warned that the nation cannot rely on billionaire CEOs of big tech to place national security above profit.

CNBC analysis suggests that policy shifts could start with companies keeping a clearer distance from politics, reducing direct business influence on legislation. If public pressure continues to rise, broader regulatory adjustments could follow. The post‑financial‑crisis tightening of banking regulations is cited as a historical example of public dissatisfaction driving policy change, though it does not guarantee the tech sector will experience the same outcome.

Even with Democrats gaining a sizable majority in both chambers, they may still lack the votes needed to override a presidential veto, so institutional checks will limit how quickly policies can change. Nonetheless, some Republican lawmakers, especially those from swing states, might cooperate with Democrats on issues like data centers, the environment and regulation.

Corporate leaders may also proactively modify their interactions with the White House to avoid the perception of being overly cozy, which could backfire. Trump originally pursued deregulation to win corporate support, but CNBC believes that shifting voter sentiment and congressional power could push policy in the opposite direction.

For tech stocks, the analysis flags a risk that Huang’s personal crisis could reshape how the industry engages with government overall. The ultimate impact will depend on congressional investigations, legislative progress, and how companies adapt to the new political landscape.

items.title: 有錢也難搶？Anthropic IPO傳擋中港資金 認購需求達6倍
items.title_en: Even With Money, It's Hard to Grab? Anthropic IPO Faces Hurdles for Mainland China and Hong Kong Investors, Subscription Demand Hits 6‑Times
paras: AI新股熱潮碰上地緣政治門檻。據外媒周五(13日)引述知情人士報導，Claude開發商Anthropic的首次公開發行(IPO)，傳出中國與香港機構投資人的申購受阻。即使近期AI股大幅震盪，這筆交易仍吸引大量買盤，潛在投資人的認購意向約為可供出售股數的6倍。
Anthropic預計11月18日定價、19日掛牌，在那斯達克全球精選市場以「ANT」為股票代號交易。公司與共同創辦人擬透過IPO及私募合計籌資最高904億美元，估值上看1.4兆美元，由高盛(GS-US)與摩根士丹利(MS-US)領銜承銷。

認購熱度高 中港機構卻傳難獲配售

知情人士表示，部分銀行已拒絕接受中國與香港機構投資人的訂單，或認為這些投資人即使申購，也不太可能取得配售。部分限制與美國規範國防產品交易的《國際武器貿易條例》(ITAR)有關。
不過，各銀行的處理方式並不一致。部分管道仍允許客戶提交訂單，最終能否分配到股票，仍取決於發行人決定。換言之，「可以下單」不代表「能夠獲配」。
這並非大型科技IPO首度出現類似限制。知情人士指出，SpaceX先前規模862億美元的IPO，也曾要求承銷商不接受中國與香港投資人的訂單，但兩地投資人在股票掛牌後仍可買進。Anthropic上市後是否採取相同安排，目前尚未明朗。
部分投資人正嘗試透過境外持股架構等方式參與，但能否成功取得配售仍不確定。Anthropic、高盛與摩根士丹利均未對相關消息置評。

1.4兆美元估值受矚目 台灣未列明示發售市場

值得注意的是，Anthropic上市文件並未明列針對中國與香港投資人的銷售限制，相關限制主要透過承銷溝通傳達，使這場熱門IPO的申購資格更受關注。
公司列出的發售市場包括美國、澳洲、加拿大、部分歐洲經濟區成員國、日本、瑞士與英國，台灣未在這份明示名單中。不過，文件也允許承銷安排機構在其他國家提供股票，因此不能僅憑名單判定台灣投資人完全無法參與；能否申購與獲配，仍須視實際發售安排而定。
這筆交易正值美中AI競爭升溫。Anthropic在公開說明書中，將美國政府加強檢視AI企業與中國國家行為者的接觸，以及美中緊張關係升高，列為營運風險。其產品目前也未在中國與香港提供服務。
即使上周AI相關股票遭遇猛烈拋售，Anthropic的IPO熱度仍持續升高，部分既有支持者甚至向新投資人提供部分配售額度。不過，約6倍的認購意向反映的是目前申購興趣，並不等同最終訂單或上市後的股價表現。
paras_en: AI IPO frenzy meets geopolitical hurdles. According to foreign media quoting insiders on Friday the 13th, Anthropic, the developer of Claude, is facing reports that institutional investors from China and Hong Kong are being blocked from subscribing to its initial public offering. Even though AI stocks have been highly volatile lately, the deal is still attracting strong buying interest, with potential investors expressing subscription intent roughly six times the number of shares on offer.

Anthropic plans to price on November 18 and list on November 19, trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker "ANT". The company and its co‑founders aim to raise up to $90.4 billion through the IPO and a private placement, valuing the firm at about $1.4 trillion, with Goldman Sachs (GS‑US) and Morgan Stanley (MS‑US) leading the underwriting syndicate.

Subscription enthusiasm is high, but Chinese and Hong Kong institutions are reportedly finding it hard to get allocations. Insiders say some banks have refused to accept orders from these investors or believe that even if orders are placed, allocations are unlikely. The restrictions are linked in part to the U.S. International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), which governs defense‑related product transactions.

However, banks are not handling the issue uniformly. Some channels still allow clients to submit orders, but whether the shares are ultimately allocated depends on the issuer’s decision. In other words, being able to place an order does not guarantee an allocation.

This is not the first time a large‑tech IPO has faced similar constraints. Insiders note that SpaceX’s previously planned $86.2 billion IPO also required underwriters to reject orders from Chinese and Hong Kong investors, though those investors were still able to buy shares after the stock began trading. It remains unclear whether Anthropic will adopt the same approach after its listing.

Some investors are trying to participate via offshore holding structures, but it is uncertain whether they will secure allocations. Anthropic, Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley have not commented on the reports.

The $1.4 trillion valuation has drawn attention, and Taiwan is not explicitly listed as a selling market. Notably, Anthropic’s prospectus does not expressly state sales restrictions for China and Hong Kong investors; the limitations are conveyed mainly through underwriting communications, making eligibility for this hot IPO a focal point.

The prospectus lists the offering markets as the United States, Australia, Canada, certain Euro‑area member states, Japan, Switzerland and the United Kingdom, with Taiwan absent from the explicit list. However, the document also permits underwriters to make the shares available in other countries, so a simple list cannot be used to conclude that Taiwanese investors are completely excluded; eligibility and allocation will depend on the actual distribution arrangements.

The transaction comes amid heightened U.S.–China AI competition. Anthropic’s filing cites increased U.S. government scrutiny of AI firms’ interactions with Chinese state actors and rising U.S.–China tensions as operational risks. Its products are currently not offered in China or Hong Kong.

Even after last week’s sharp sell‑off in AI‑related stocks, interest in Anthropic’s IPO remains strong, with some existing supporters offering portions of their allocations to new investors. However, the roughly six‑fold subscription interest reflects current demand and does not equate to final order sizes or post‑listing share performance.

items.title: 以後買東西只要交代AI？ChatGPT推代付款 每筆仍須本人點頭
paras: OpenAI周五(13日)宣布推出ChatGPT Wallet支付功能，讓旗下AI代理「dots」能代替使用者付款購物，首波僅開放美國境內年滿18歲、持有符合資格美國發行卡片的ChatGPT Pro訂閱用戶使用。每筆交易仍須由使用者確認，並透過臉部辨識或指紋等安全驗證核准，AI代理不會取得使用者的實際信用卡資料。
這項功能由OpenAI與美國運通(AXP-US)、萬事達卡(MA-US)及Visa(V-US)合作打造，首波開放給美國境內年滿18歲、持有符合資格美國發行卡片的ChatGPT Pro訂閱用戶，既有信用卡回饋與保障也可保留。

每筆交易須本人核准 AI代理透過代碼付款

符合資格的使用者只需輸入一次卡片資料，之後便可要求dots尋找想購買的商品。付款前，使用者能檢視商品、總金額與選用卡片，再透過Face ID或指紋辨識等方式核准交易。
OpenAI表示，支付網路會提供「支付代碼」，內含限於特定交易使用的卡號、安全碼與到期日，取代實際信用卡資訊。因此，商家與AI代理都不會看見使用者的真實卡片資料。
初期仍採逐筆核准，但OpenAI預期，未來使用者可在設定金額上限、商品類別或授權期間等條件後，將購物任務交由代理執行。
OpenAI商業化與支付產品主管Chaya Nayak接受《CNBC》訪問時表示，目前重點是與商家及支付網路夥伴合作，建立安全、容易使用的基礎。她指出，當使用者找到真正想買的商品，OpenAI希望能協助他們完成最後的購買步驟。

初期不抽交易佣金 商家接受度成發展關鍵

ChatGPT Wallet未來可能為OpenAI開闢新收入來源，但公司表示，推出初期不會從交易中抽成，而是先建立商家關係，擴大ChatGPT作為購物平台的角色。
OpenAI過去一年持續投入AI購物服務，但早期嘗試並非都順利。公司去年秋季推出「Instant Checkout」即時結帳功能後，很快調整方向，今年3月再推出改版購物體驗，著重協助使用者搜尋與比較商品。Nayak表示，新錢包功能正是建立在這些商品探索服務之上。
美國運通執行副總裁暨全球創新主管Luke Gebb指出，先在有限範圍推出，是確認功能正常運作的適當方式。據報導，截至第三季底，ChatGPT每周活躍用戶已超過12億，付費用戶接近1億，龐大使用者基礎也讓OpenAI未來具備擴大服務規模的空間。
不過，AI代理代購仍面臨商家端的限制。聯合航空(UAL-US)周三表示，將阻止代理存取其系統訂票；亞馬遜(AMZN-US)也禁止代理在其平台代購商品，意味著錢包上線並不代表能在所有網站使用。
OpenAI坦言，AI代理購物仍處於早期階段，並同步發布工具與指引，協助商家避免網站意外封鎖其代理。Nayak表示，整個產業仍需要時間建立適當基礎設施，才能讓跨網站購物體驗更加流暢。

paras: 美元週四(12日)走強，升至約19個月以來最高水準。由於投資人重新評估聯準會（Fed）未來的利率政策走向，市場對聯準會採取更強硬升息立場的預期升高，進而推升美國公債殖利率。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.3%，報103.16，仍維持在2025年4月以來的最高水準。
本週多位聯準會官員警告，通膨仍維持在頑強的高檔水準。其中一些官員表示，如果物價壓力未能緩解，他們不排除升息50個基點的可能性。
週二公布的美國通膨數據強於預期，進一步強化了這項看法，也促使交易員提高對聯準會進一步緊縮貨幣政策的預期。
歐元兌美元下跌0.28%，至1歐元兌1.10585美元，創下2025年4月以來最低。
美元兌瑞士法郎上漲0.14%，至0.834瑞郎，達到一個月以來新高。
Moneycorp交易與結構性商品部門主管 Eugene Epstein 表示，「美元走強幾乎完全是受到市場對聯準會政策預期的影響。如果觀察聯邦基金利率期貨，過去幾天它與美元走勢之間的相關性相當高。而聯邦基金利率期貨之所以走高，主要有兩個原因：（一）消費者物價指數（CPI）高於預期；（二）多位聯準會官員發表了相當多偏鷹的言論。」
根據芝商所（CME） FedWatch 工具，投資人目前預估聯準會在12月升息的機率已達91%。通常會隨聯準會利率預期同步變動的美國2年期公債殖利率，最新上升10.79個基點，來到4.835%。美國10年期公債殖利率則上升7.94個基點，來到5.068%。
包括高盛在內的一些券商，目前甚至預期聯準會除了12月升息之外，明年初還可能再升息一次。
日元走勢
日本最高貨幣外交官三村淳（Atsushi Mimura）週四警告市場參與者，對於今年夏季日本政府曾進場干預匯市一事，「現在還不是可以忘記的時候」。
由於日元再次逼近1美元兌160日元重要關卡，市場對日本政府可能再次干預匯市的警戒也隨之升高。
根據《路透社》一項分析師調查，許多分析師預期，日本央行（BoJ）最快可能在下個月升息。週四公布數據也進一步強化了這項看法。數據顯示，日本10月份批發物價年增率重新加速至7.1%，高於9月份的6.8%。
日元兌美元下跌0.13%，至1美元兌159.975日元，創下9月以來最低水準。
澳幣兌美元下跌0.58%，至0.6808美元，創下今年1月以來最低。
紐幣兌美元則下跌0.25%，來到0.5548美元。
